chapters.title: 跟随一个像素
chapters.caption: 纸上的一个点，要经过一整条成像链。
chapters.captionEn: One printed dot travels through an entire imaging process.

chapters.title: 认识感光鼓
chapters.caption: 激光照的是感光鼓，纸张走另一条路。
chapters.captionEn: The laser reaches the drum; paper follows a separate path.

chapters.title: 均匀充电
chapters.caption: 先把鼓面充成均匀负电位。
chapters.captionEn: First, give the drum an even negative potential.

chapters.title: 用光写入
chapters.caption: 曝光改变电位，先写出看不见的图案。
chapters.captionEn: Exposure changes potential, creating an invisible pattern.

chapters.title: 碳粉显影
chapters.caption: 带电碳粉把电位图案变成可见图案。
chapters.captionEn: Charged toner makes the electrical pattern visible.

chapters.title: 看清电场
chapters.caption: 显影取决于各部件之间的电位差。
chapters.captionEn: Development depends on potential differences between components.

chapters.title: 把像交给纸
chapters.caption: 转印电场让碳粉离开鼓面，来到纸面。
chapters.captionEn: The transfer field moves toner from drum to paper.

chapters.title: 热与压力
chapters.caption: 加热软化树脂，压力帮助碳粉黏合纸纤维。
chapters.captionEn: Heat softens toner resin; pressure helps it bond to paper.

chapters.title: 清洁再出发
chapters.caption: 清掉残粉与残余电荷，鼓面才可以重新使用。
chapters.captionEn: Remove leftover toner and charge before reusing the drum.

chapters.title: 连起来看
chapters.caption: 充电 → 曝光 → 显影 → 转印 → 定影。
chapters.captionEn: Charge, expose, develop, transfer, then fuse.

chapters.title: 机械同步
chapters.caption: 共同节距和表面速度，让各部件配合。
chapters.captionEn: Shared pitch and matched surface speeds coordinate the parts.

chapters.title: 带走一个判断
chapters.caption: 激光写电荷，碳粉留图案，定影让它牢固。
chapters.captionEn: Light writes charge; toner forms the image; fusing makes it last.

chapters.title: 从踏板出发
chapters.caption: 跟住金色链节，看动力怎样绕一圈。
chapters.captionEn: Follow the gold link around the drivetrain.

chapters.title: 链节怎样接住齿
chapters.caption: 齿与链节共享同一个节距。
chapters.captionEn: Teeth and links share the same pitch.

chapters.title: 数一圈
chapters.caption: 前链盘转一圈，拉过与齿数相同数量的链节。
chapters.captionEn: One chainring turn advances one link per tooth.

chapters.title: 看见传动比
chapters.caption: 后轴转速 = 踏频 × 前齿数 ÷ 后齿数。
chapters.captionEn: Rear speed equals cadence times front teeth divided by rear teeth.

chapters.title: 换小飞轮
chapters.caption: 相同踏频，小飞轮让后轴转得更多。
chapters.captionEn: At the same cadence, a smaller sprocket turns the axle faster.

chapters.title: 速度的代价
chapters.caption: 同样的链条拉力，小飞轮提供的轴上扭矩更小。
chapters.captionEn: For the same chain pull, a smaller sprocket gives less axle torque.

chapters.title: 换大飞轮
chapters.caption: 大飞轮以较低轮速换取更有利的力矩。
chapters.captionEn: A larger rear sprocket trades wheel speed for torque.

chapters.title: 把路抬起来
chapters.caption: 坡度增加，维持相同速度需要更大的驱动力。
chapters.captionEn: A steeper road requires more driving force at the same speed.

chapters.title: 换节奏
chapters.caption: 踏频改变，链速与轮速一起改变。
chapters.captionEn: Changing cadence changes both chain speed and wheel speed.

chapters.title: 能量没有免费午餐
chapters.caption: 省力不等于少做相同路程所需的功。
chapters.captionEn: Less pedal force does not erase the work of a climb.

chapters.title: 实际骑行的边界
chapters.caption: 读数表示维持所选踏频所需的力和功率。
chapters.captionEn: The readouts show the effort needed to maintain the selected cadence.

chapters.title: 回到上坡
chapters.caption: 前小后大更轻，前大后小更快。
chapters.captionEn: Smaller front and larger rear favor easier pedaling.

chapters.title: 拉起再松手
chapters.caption: 高度先储存能量，松手后开始转化。
chapters.captionEn: Height stores energy that motion can release.

chapters.title: 为什么往回摆
chapters.caption: 重力沿圆弧方向的分量，把摆球拉向最低点。
chapters.captionEn: The tangential part of gravity pulls the bob toward the bottom.

chapters.title: 经过最低点
chapters.caption: 最低处势能最小，速度最大。
chapters.captionEn: At the bottom, potential energy is lowest and speed is highest.

chapters.title: 在另一端转身
chapters.caption: 到达端点，速度降到零，方向反转。
chapters.captionEn: At an endpoint, speed reaches zero before reversing.

chapters.title: 一整个周期
chapters.caption: 从同一位置、同一运动方向回来，才算一周期。
chapters.captionEn: A full period returns to the same position and direction.

chapters.title: 换一条长线
chapters.caption: 摆长增加，周期按平方根关系增大。
chapters.captionEn: Period grows with the square root of length.

chapters.title: 改变质量
chapters.caption: 理想单摆里，质量改变能量，不改变周期。
chapters.captionEn: In an ideal pendulum, mass changes energy, not period.

chapters.title: 搬到月球
chapters.caption: 重力减弱，相同摆长的钟摆走得更慢。
chapters.captionEn: Weaker gravity makes the same pendulum slower.

chapters.title: 大角度的差别
chapters.caption: 大摆幅会偏离小角度周期公式。
chapters.captionEn: Large swings depart from the small-angle period formula.

chapters.title: 增加阻尼
chapters.caption: 阻尼把机械能转移给环境。
chapters.captionEn: Damping transfers mechanical energy to the surroundings.

chapters.title: 真实的摆钟
chapters.caption: 真实摆钟需要补充损耗，并保持稳定的摆动。
chapters.captionEn: A real clock must replace losses and maintain a steady swing.

chapters.title: 分清三个问题
chapters.caption: 摆长和重力定节奏，阻尼改振幅，质量改能量尺度。
chapters.captionEn: Length and gravity set the rhythm; damping changes amplitude.

chapters.title: 热去了哪里
chapters.caption: 冰箱把箱内的热搬到房间里。
chapters.captionEn: A refrigerator moves heat from its interior into the room.

chapters.title: 一个闭合回路
chapters.caption: 制冷剂在封闭管路中循环，正常运行不被消耗。
chapters.captionEn: Refrigerant circulates in a sealed loop rather than being consumed.

chapters.title: 为什么需要压缩
chapters.caption: 压缩机做功，把蒸气推向高压、高温状态。
chapters.captionEn: Compressor work raises the vapor to higher pressure and temperature.

chapters.title: 背后的热管
chapters.caption: 冷凝器向空气放热，让蒸气凝成液体。
chapters.captionEn: The condenser releases heat while vapor becomes liquid.

chapters.title: 压力分成两侧
chapters.caption: 高压侧与低压侧，让同一种制冷剂在不同温度下换热。
chapters.captionEn: High and low pressures let one refrigerant exchange heat at different temperatures.

chapters.title: 经过节流装置
chapters.caption: 节流降压，一部分液体闪蒸。
chapters.captionEn: Throttling reduces pressure and flashes some liquid into vapor.

chapters.title: 在箱内沸腾
chapters.caption: 蒸发需要能量，热从食物和空气进入制冷剂。
chapters.captionEn: Evaporation takes energy from the food and air.

chapters.title: 算一笔能量账
chapters.caption: 放到房间的热 = 箱内移出的热 + 输入电功。
chapters.captionEn: Heat released equals heat removed plus electrical work.

chapters.title: 效率怎样理解
chapters.caption: COP 描述每份电功搬运多少热，不是能量创造率。
chapters.captionEn: COP measures heat moved per unit of work, not energy creation.

chapters.title: 开门能降室温吗
chapters.titleEn: Can an open fridge cool a room?
chapters.caption: 门一直打开，房间最终多得到压缩机输入的能量。
chapters.captionEn: With the door open, the room gains the compressor input overall.

chapters.title: 再走完整一圈
chapters.caption: 压缩、冷凝、节流、蒸发，四步缺一不可。
chapters.captionEn: Compression, condensation, throttling and evaporation form one cycle.

chapters.title: 记住两面
chapters.caption: 看见冷的一面，也要找到热被送去的地方。
chapters.captionEn: Whenever you see cooling, look for where the heat is rejected.

chapters.title: 先看声压
chapters.caption: 声音是空气压力随时间的起伏。
chapters.captionEn: Sound is a variation in air pressure over time.

chapters.title: 两个同向的波
chapters.caption: 波峰对波峰，叠加后的起伏变大。
chapters.captionEn: Peak meets peak, and the combined variation grows.

chapters.title: 慢慢错开
chapters.caption: 相位描述两道波在周期中的相对位置。
chapters.captionEn: Phase describes the waves’ relative positions in a cycle.

chapters.title: 正好反过来
chapters.caption: 相同幅度、相反相位，在这个位置完全抵消。
chapters.captionEn: Equal amplitudes and opposite phases cancel at this point.

chapters.title: 幅度也要匹配
chapters.caption: 相位对了，幅度不匹配仍会留下残余。
chapters.captionEn: Correct phase still leaves a residual if amplitudes differ.

chapters.title: 恢复匹配
chapters.caption: 把幅度调回来，残余再次降低。
chapters.captionEn: Matching the amplitudes reduces the residual again.

chapters.title: 晚到两毫秒
chapters.caption: 额外延迟会破坏原来的反相关系。
chapters.captionEn: Extra delay breaks the original phase alignment.

chapters.title: 频率改变后
chapters.caption: 同样的延迟，在高频里对应更大的相位转动。
chapters.captionEn: The same delay spans more of a cycle at higher frequencies.

chapters.title: 不是全屋静音
chapters.caption: 这个波形实验只描述一个位置的叠加。
chapters.captionEn: This waveform experiment describes superposition at one point.

chapters.title: 耳机怎样跟上
chapters.caption: 麦克风、控制器和扬声器持续配合。
chapters.captionEn: Microphones, a controller and speakers work together continuously.

chapters.title: 低频更容易理解
chapters.caption: 稳定低频的周期较长，时间误差相对更容易控制。
chapters.captionEn: Long, steady low-frequency cycles make timing easier to manage.

chapters.title: 用三件事检查
chapters.caption: 抵消要同时看幅度、相位与延迟。
chapters.captionEn: Cancellation depends on amplitude, phase and delay together.

chapters.title: 位置从时间开始
chapters.caption: 卫星发来时间信息，接收机据此估计距离。
chapters.captionEn: Satellite timing signals let a receiver estimate distances.

chapters.title: 一个距离
chapters.caption: 在二维里，与一个点等距的位置组成一个圆。
chapters.captionEn: In two dimensions, equal distance from one point forms a circle.

chapters.title: 第二个距离
chapters.caption: 两个圆通常相交于两个候选位置。
chapters.captionEn: Two circles generally leave two candidate positions.

chapters.title: 第三条约束
chapters.caption: 第三个距离排除另一个交点。
chapters.captionEn: A third distance removes the other intersection.

chapters.title: 把解代回去
chapters.caption: 把求出的点代回每一条距离，检查残差。
chapters.captionEn: Substitute the solution into every distance and check the residuals.

chapters.title: 从圆进入球面
chapters.caption: 三维中，等距离的位置组成球面。
chapters.captionEn: In three dimensions, a range defines a sphere.

chapters.title: 手机时钟不够准
chapters.caption: 接收机时钟误差会给多条测距带来共同偏移。
chapters.captionEn: Receiver clock error adds a common bias to measured ranges.

chapters.title: 第四个未知量
chapters.caption: 三个位置坐标，加一个时钟偏差。
chapters.captionEn: Three position coordinates plus one receiver clock bias.

chapters.title: 校正共同误差
chapters.caption: 扣除共同偏差，球面重新对齐。
chapters.captionEn: Removing the common bias brings the spheres into alignment.

chapters.title: 卫星也讲站位
chapters.caption: 卫星分布太集中，会让某些方向的位置更难确定。
chapters.captionEn: Clustered satellites make some position directions harder to resolve.

chapters.title: 实际天空更复杂
chapters.titleEn: The real sky is more complicated
chapters.caption: 大气、反射与轨道误差还会影响真实测距。
chapters.captionEn: Atmosphere, reflections and orbit errors also affect real measurements.

chapters.title: 重新认识蓝点
chapters.caption: 蓝点是多条距离与时间信息共同约束出的解。
chapters.captionEn: The blue dot is a solution constrained by distance and time.

chapters.title: 一次回车
chapters.caption: 一次加载包含寻找地址、连接、传输和绘制。
chapters.captionEn: A page load includes lookup, connection, transfer and rendering.

chapters.title: 先找地址
chapters.caption: DNS 把域名查询成可连接的地址。
chapters.captionEn: DNS resolves a domain name into an address to contact.

chapters.title: 建立可靠通道
chapters.caption: 这里用 TCP 握手说明连接建立。
chapters.captionEn: This model uses a TCP handshake to establish a connection.

chapters.title: 协商加密
chapters.caption: TLS 验证服务端身份，并建立加密会话。
chapters.captionEn: TLS verifies server identity and establishes an encrypted session.

chapters.title: 请求到服务器
chapters.caption: 发出请求后，还要等待服务器处理。
chapters.captionEn: Sending the request is followed by server processing time.

chapters.title: 内容分段回来
chapters.caption: 响应逐步抵达，页面还会需要样式、脚本和图片。
chapters.captionEn: Responses arrive progressively, with styles, scripts and images also needed.

chapters.title: 代码变成像素
chapters.caption: 解析、布局、绘制与合成，把内容变成画面。
chapters.captionEn: Parsing, layout, painting and compositing produce the image.

chapters.title: 第二次访问
chapters.caption: 地址缓存与连接复用，能省去部分往返。
chapters.captionEn: Address caching and connection reuse remove some round trips.

chapters.title: 直接读本地资源
chapters.caption: 新鲜资源命中缓存时，可以省去该资源的网络请求。
chapters.captionEn: A fresh cached resource can avoid its network request.

chapters.title: 如果丢了一段
chapters.titleEn: What if a segment is lost?
chapters.caption: 丢包和重传，会延长内容到达的等待。
chapters.captionEn: Loss and retransmission can delay content delivery.

chapters.title: 换一条更远的路
chapters.caption: 时延会影响多个阶段，不只影响下载。
chapters.captionEn: Latency affects several stages, not just downloading.

chapters.title: 按阶段找瓶颈
chapters.caption: 先分清网络、服务端和渲染，再决定优化什么。
chapters.captionEn: Separate network, server and rendering work before optimizing.

chapters.title: 从一小块开始
chapters.caption: 把图像放大成 8 × 8 像素块。
chapters.captionEn: Zoom in to an eight-by-eight pixel block.

chapters.title: 换一种表达
chapters.caption: 像素值可以改写成不同频率图案的组合。
chapters.captionEn: Pixel values can be represented as a mixture of frequency patterns.

chapters.title: 认识基底图案
chapters.caption: 每一种基底，都表示一种方向与速度的明暗变化。
chapters.captionEn: Each basis pattern represents a direction and rate of brightness variation.

chapters.title: 先只留平均亮度
chapters.caption: 只留下直流系数，重建结果是一片均匀亮度。
chapters.captionEn: Keeping only the DC coefficient reconstructs a uniform block.

chapters.title: 加回低频
chapters.caption: 低频先恢复大范围轮廓。
chapters.captionEn: Low frequencies restore broad structure first.

chapters.title: 加回高频
chapters.caption: 高频让边缘和细小变化逐步恢复。
chapters.captionEn: High frequencies restore edges and finer variations.

chapters.title: 变换不是压缩魔法
chapters.titleEn: The transform is not the loss
chapters.caption: DCT 改变表示方式；量化才开始丢失精度。
chapters.captionEn: DCT changes representation; quantization discards precision.

chapters.title: 把量化变粗
chapters.caption: 量化步长变大，更多系数变成零。
chapters.captionEn: Larger quantization steps turn more coefficients into zero.

chapters.title: 看误差而非口号
chapters.caption: 重建误差直接比较原始像素与恢复像素。
chapters.captionEn: Reconstruction error compares original and recovered pixels.

chapters.title: 颜色还有另一条路
chapters.caption: 色度降采样减少颜色细节，和亮度块量化不同。
chapters.captionEn: Chroma subsampling reduces color detail separately from luminance quantization.

chapters.title: 零怎样节省空间
chapters.caption: 系数顺序与熵编码，进一步利用零和重复模式。
chapters.captionEn: Coefficient ordering and entropy coding exploit zeros and repetition.

chapters.title: 把取舍看完整
chapters.caption: 变换、量化、重建，让细节与表示成本形成取舍。
chapters.captionEn: Transform, quantize and reconstruct to see the tradeoff.

chapters.title: 独立的方向
chapters.caption: 维度表示定位所需的独立坐标数量。
chapters.captionEn: Dimension counts the independent coordinates needed to locate a point.

chapters.title: 从线到面
chapters.titleEn: From a line to a plane
chapters.caption: 线段沿新方向移动，扫出正方形。
chapters.captionEn: Move a segment in a new direction to sweep out a square.

chapters.title: 从面到体
chapters.titleEn: From a plane to a volume
chapters.caption: 正方形沿第三个方向移动，扫出立方体。
chapters.captionEn: Move the square in a third direction to sweep out a cube.

chapters.title: 认出投影
chapters.caption: 屏幕上的立方体，本来就只是二维投影。
chapters.captionEn: The cube on your screen is already a two-dimensional projection.

chapters.title: 再做一次同样的事
chapters.caption: 沿第四个独立方向复制并连接立方体。
chapters.captionEn: Copy and connect the cube along a fourth independent direction.

chapters.title: 数结构，不猜外壳
chapters.caption: 超立方体有 16 个顶点和 32 条边。
chapters.captionEn: A tesseract has sixteen vertices and thirty-two edges.

chapters.title: 旋转之后
chapters.caption: 投影形状改变，原结构的连接关系保持不变。
chapters.captionEn: Projection changes shape while the original connectivity stays fixed.

chapters.title: 换成切片
chapters.caption: 切片只保留物体与某个平面的交集。
chapters.captionEn: A slice keeps only the intersection with a chosen plane.

chapters.title: 一串切片
chapters.caption: 圆从小到大再变小，记录球体不同高度的截面。
chapters.captionEn: Circles grow and shrink across the sphere’s different heights.

chapters.title: 特征也是维度
chapters.caption: 质量、甜度和含水量，可以成为不同的特征坐标。
chapters.captionEn: Mass, sweetness and water content can be feature coordinates.

chapters.title: 换轴不换水果
chapters.caption: 更换展示的特征，只改变这张图的视角。
chapters.captionEn: Changing displayed features changes the view, not the objects.

chapters.title: 三种表示，分开理解
chapters.caption: 坐标、投影和切片，是理解高维的不同工具。
chapters.captionEn: Coordinates, projections and slices offer different tools for higher dimensions.

chapters.title: 预测从哪里开始
chapters.caption: 同一句输入，训练前也会产生一组概率。
chapters.captionEn: Even an untrained model produces probabilities for the same input.

chapters.title: 从字到词元
chapters.caption: 教学模型把九个字符作为词表。
chapters.captionEn: This teaching model uses a vocabulary of nine characters.

chapters.title: 嵌入到向量
chapters.caption: 嵌入表把每个词元映射成一组可学习的数。
chapters.captionEn: An embedding table maps each token to learnable numbers.

chapters.title: 顺序也要进入计算
chapters.caption: 位置与词元一起进入模型，顺序不能丢。
chapters.captionEn: Position accompanies token information so order is represented.

chapters.title: 看注意力
chapters.caption: 每个位置按计算得到的权重汇集上下文。
chapters.captionEn: Each position gathers context using calculated attention weights.

chapters.title: 不能偷看答案
chapters.caption: 因果遮罩阻止当前位置读取未来词元。
chapters.captionEn: A causal mask prevents a position from reading future tokens.

chapters.title: 概率与正确答案
chapters.caption: 正确词元的概率越低，这次预测的损失越大。
chapters.captionEn: Lower probability for the target produces a larger prediction loss.

chapters.title: 梯度指向哪里
chapters.caption: 反向传播计算损失对各权重的局部变化率。
chapters.captionEn: Backpropagation calculates how loss changes locally with each weight.

chapters.title: 更新并重复
chapters.caption: 优化器利用梯度更新权重，再处理新的训练样本。
chapters.captionEn: The optimizer updates weights from gradients, then processes more examples.

chapters.title: 学会一小组规律
chapters.titleEn: Learn a small set of patterns
chapters.caption: 更多训练让小语料中的关联逐渐进入权重。
chapters.captionEn: Repeated training puts patterns from this tiny dataset into the weights.

chapters.title: 进入生成阶段
chapters.caption: 生成读取已经学到的权重，不再反向传播更新。
chapters.captionEn: Generation uses the learned weights without updating them.

chapters.title: 选出一个词元
chapters.caption: 从分布选出的词元，被追加到上下文。
chapters.captionEn: A token selected from the distribution is appended to the context.

chapters.title: 再预测一次
chapters.caption: 新的上下文再进入同一个网络，生成逐步展开。
chapters.captionEn: The new context reenters the same network for another prediction.

chapters.title: 把两条过程分开
chapters.caption: 训练改变参数；生成在固定参数下反复预测。
chapters.captionEn: Training changes parameters; generation repeatedly predicts with fixed parameters.

chapters.title: 同一批乘客
chapters.caption: 公平比较策略，先固定乘客与到达时间。
chapters.captionEn: Fix passengers and arrival times before comparing strategies.

chapters.title: 先来先服务
chapters.caption: 按照任务到达顺序安排，不提前照顾后来的近任务。
chapters.captionEn: Serve tasks in arrival order without favoring later nearby requests.

chapters.title: 距离也是时间
chapters.caption: 先来的任务可能很远，近处乘客仍要等。
chapters.captionEn: An earlier distant task can keep nearby passengers waiting.

chapters.title: 记录整批结果
chapters.caption: 只看某一位乘客，不能代表整个策略。
chapters.captionEn: One passenger’s experience cannot represent the whole strategy.

chapters.title: 改为最近优先
chapters.caption: 同一份客流重放，这次优先响应较近任务。
chapters.captionEn: Replay the same demand, prioritizing nearby tasks.

chapters.title: 局部好处
chapters.caption: 就近响应通常能减少某些接客路程。
chapters.captionEn: Nearby assignment can shorten some pickup trips.

chapters.title: 方向不能忽略
chapters.caption: 位置接近，不代表行驶方向和目的地合适。
chapters.captionEn: A nearby car may still be traveling in an unhelpful direction.

chapters.title: 顺路停靠
chapters.caption: 保持方向，把顺路的接送任务合在一起。
chapters.captionEn: Maintain direction and combine compatible pickup and drop-off stops.

chapters.title: 少折返不等于最优
chapters.titleEn: Fewer reversals are not a proof of optimality
chapters.caption: 顺路合并任务可能更高效，也会影响个别人的等待。
chapters.captionEn: Combining stops can improve efficiency while changing individual waits.

chapters.title: 把结果放一起
chapters.titleEn: Put the results side by side
chapters.caption: 使用完整模拟结果比较平均等待与行程。
chapters.captionEn: Compare waiting and travel using complete simulation results.

chapters.title: 真实楼宇还有约束
chapters.caption: 容量、开关门与安全约束，让真实调度更复杂。
chapters.captionEn: Capacity, door operations and safety constraints make real dispatch more complex.

chapters.title: 学会公平比较
chapters.caption: 固定输入、完整统计，再讨论策略的取舍。
chapters.captionEn: Fix the input, complete the accounting, then compare tradeoffs.

chapters.title: 没有事故的环路
chapters.caption: 没有路口和事故，车流仍可能形成拥堵波。
chapters.captionEn: Traffic can form a jam wave without an intersection or incident.

chapters.title: 每辆车只看前方
chapters.caption: 跟车行为取决于车距、相对速度与期望速度。
chapters.captionEn: Following behavior depends on gap, relative speed and desired speed.

chapters.title: 轻踩一次刹车
chapters.caption: 金色车辆短暂减速，扰动开始。
chapters.captionEn: The gold car briefly slows, starting a disturbance.

chapters.title: 反应传给后车
chapters.caption: 后车相继调整，减速影响向车队后方传递。
chapters.captionEn: Successive reactions carry the slowdown toward the back of the queue.

chapters.title: 车和波方向不同
chapters.caption: 车辆向前，拥堵波可以向后传播。
chapters.captionEn: Cars move forward while a congestion wave can travel backward.

chapters.title: 原来的车已经走了
chapters.titleEn: The original car has moved on
chapters.caption: 最初扰动结束，车流反应仍可能继续。
chapters.captionEn: The initial disturbance can end while the traffic response continues.

chapters.title: 把时间画出来
chapters.titleEn: Draw time as well as position
chapters.caption: 时空图记录每个时刻、每个位置的速度。
chapters.captionEn: The space-time view records speed across position and time.

chapters.title: 读懂斜纹
chapters.caption: 斜纹表示慢行区域随时间移动。
chapters.captionEn: Diagonal bands show a slow region moving over time.

chapters.title: 换一组密度
chapters.caption: 车辆更少时，同样的扰动可能更容易被吸收。
chapters.captionEn: With fewer cars, the same disturbance may be easier to absorb.

chapters.title: 留出反应空间
chapters.caption: 更平缓的速度调整，有助于减少扰动的放大。
chapters.captionEn: Smoother speed adjustments can reduce disturbance amplification.

chapters.title: 模型的边界
chapters.caption: 单车道环路忽略换道、路口与驾驶者差异。
chapters.captionEn: The single-lane ring omits lane changes, junctions and driver variation.

chapters.title: 看系统，不只看前车
chapters.caption: 局部反应连接起来，产生整体的拥堵波。
chapters.captionEn: Connected local reactions produce a system-wide congestion wave.

chapters.title: 一个点发出的光
chapters.caption: 先跟住一个物点，它的光会走许多条路。
chapters.captionEn: Follow one object point: its light takes many paths.

chapters.title: 把光线拐回来
chapters.caption: 来自同一点的光，在透镜后改变方向。
chapters.captionEn: The lens redirects rays from the same point.

chapters.title: 屏幕来到交点
chapters.caption: 移动成像屏，让分散的光重新落在同一点。
chapters.captionEn: Move the screen until the rays meet at one point.

chapters.title: 为什么是倒像
chapters.caption: 物点向下，像点向上；整个图像因此倒立。
chapters.captionEn: The object point moves down while its image moves up.

chapters.title: 物体移近以后
chapters.caption: 物体靠近透镜，清晰像面移得更远。
chapters.captionEn: A closer object needs a more distant image plane.

chapters.title: 重新对焦
chapters.caption: 让成像屏追上新的像面，光点再次收拢。
chapters.captionEn: The screen reaches the new image plane and the spot contracts.

chapters.title: 焦距改变什么
chapters.caption: 同样的物距，更长焦距带来更远、更大的像。
chapters.captionEn: At the same object distance, longer focal length gives a farther, larger image.

chapters.title: 越过焦点的边界
chapters.caption: 物体进入焦距以内，光线不再在屏上会聚。
chapters.captionEn: Inside the focal distance, the rays no longer meet on a screen.

chapters.title: 一张照片里的距离
chapters.caption: 花朵、前景和灯光，在不同距离上。
chapters.captionEn: The flower, foreground and lights sit at different distances.

chapters.title: 数字大，开口小
chapters.titleEn: A bigger number, a smaller opening
chapters.caption: 光圈值是焦距除以入瞳直径。
chapters.captionEn: The f-number is focal length divided by entrance-pupil diameter.

chapters.title: 少进来的光
chapters.caption: 同样快门，光圈每收一挡，进光量约减半。
chapters.captionEn: At equal shutter time, each full stop roughly halves the light.

chapters.title: 散景从哪里来
chapters.caption: 离焦光束被屏截开，一个点成为一小片。
chapters.captionEn: A defocused light bundle reaches the sensor as a patch.

chapters.title: 清楚不是一道墙
chapters.caption: 小光圈扩大可接受的清晰范围，不会让所有距离完全合焦。
chapters.captionEn: A smaller opening widens acceptable sharpness; it does not focus every distance perfectly.

chapters.title: 把焦点交给背景
chapters.caption: 对焦距离改变，清晰范围跟着移动。
chapters.captionEn: Changing focus moves the region of acceptable sharpness.

chapters.title: 不能无限缩小
chapters.titleEn: Why smaller is not always better
chapters.caption: 小光圈减少离焦模糊，却增加衍射光斑。
chapters.captionEn: Stopping down reduces defocus but enlarges the diffraction spot.

chapters.title: 为这张照片做选择
chapters.caption: 先决定想让谁清楚，再平衡光圈和曝光。
chapters.captionEn: Choose what should be sharp, then balance aperture and exposure.

chapters.title: 四次行程，一次燃烧
chapters.caption: 活塞走过四个行程，曲轴转过两圈。
chapters.captionEn: Four piston strokes take two crankshaft revolutions.

chapters.title: 气门先打开
chapters.caption: 进气门打开，下降的活塞让气体进入。
chapters.captionEn: The open intake valve admits gas as the piston descends.

chapters.title: 把同一份气体压紧
chapters.caption: 两扇气门关闭，容积缩小，压力上升。
chapters.captionEn: Both valves close; falling volume raises pressure.

chapters.title: 火花改变压力
chapters.caption: 接近上止点时点火，高压气体开始推动活塞。
chapters.captionEn: Ignition near the top creates pressure that pushes the piston.

chapters.title: 压力换成转动
chapters.caption: 气体膨胀，连杆把活塞的推动传给曲柄。
chapters.captionEn: Expanding gas drives the piston, rod and offset crank.

chapters.title: 给下一次进气腾地方
chapters.titleEn: Make room for the next charge
chapters.caption: 排气门打开，上行活塞把废气推出。
chapters.captionEn: The open exhaust valve lets the rising piston expel spent gas.

chapters.title: 同样压力，不同力臂
chapters.caption: 转矩同时取决于压力和曲柄—连杆的几何。
chapters.captionEn: Torque depends on pressure and the crank–rod geometry together.

chapters.title: 把一个循环画出来
chapters.titleEn: Draw the work of one cycle
chapters.caption: 压力—容积曲线包围的面积，是理想循环净功。
chapters.captionEn: The area inside the pressure–volume loop is net ideal-cycle work.

chapters.title: 四种部件，一套轮系
chapters.caption: 先把齿轮与行星架装到位，再开始转动。
chapters.captionEn: Assemble the gears and carrier before starting rotation.

chapters.title: 一颗齿轮，两种转动
chapters.caption: 行星轮在自转，它的轴心也在公转。
chapters.captionEn: The planet spins while its axle travels around the sun.

chapters.title: 数一圈输出
chapters.caption: 内齿圈固定，太阳轮转 3.5 圈，行星架转一圈。
chapters.captionEn: With the ring fixed, 3.5 sun turns produce one carrier turn.

chapters.title: 慢一些，更有力
chapters.caption: 理想情况下，降速 3.5 倍对应输出转矩增大 3.5 倍。
chapters.captionEn: Ideally, a 3.5-fold reduction gives 3.5 times the output torque.

chapters.title: 换一个固定部件
chapters.caption: 固定太阳轮，从内齿圈输入，行星架以另一比例跟随。
chapters.captionEn: Hold the sun and drive the ring for a different carrier speed.

chapters.title: 让输出倒过来
chapters.caption: 固定行星架，行星轮原地自转，内齿圈反向输出。
chapters.captionEn: Hold the carrier: the planets spin in place and the ring reverses.

chapters.title: 一起转，就不再相对转
chapters.caption: 把太阳轮与内齿圈连接，整个轮系一起转动。
chapters.captionEn: Couple the sun and ring, and the whole gearset turns together.

chapters.title: 约束，决定结果
chapters.caption: 比较相同的一圈输入，观察不同角色与约束下的输出。
chapters.captionEn: Compare one input turn across different member roles and constraints.

chapters.title: 让光住进玻璃里
chapters.caption: 保护层淡出，留下纤芯、包层和一束正在前进的光。
chapters.captionEn: Fade the protective layer to reveal the core, cladding and moving light.

chapters.title: 先看一次相遇
chapters.caption: 光从玻璃射向空气，一部分反射，另一部分折射。
chapters.captionEn: Light meeting air from glass splits into reflected and refracted parts.

chapters.title: 跨过临界角
chapters.caption: 超过临界角后，空气中不再有传播的折射光线。
chapters.captionEn: Above the critical angle, no refracted ray propagates into the air.

chapters.title: 回到纤芯与包层
chapters.caption: 纤芯折射率略高于包层；合适的角度使光连续全反射。
chapters.captionEn: A slightly higher core index supports repeated total internal reflection.

chapters.title: 不是任何方向都能进入
chapters.caption: 入射方向超出接收范围，纤芯里的光量逐次减少。
chapters.captionEn: Outside the acceptance cone, power remaining in the core decreases at each encounter.

chapters.title: 把折射率差拿走
chapters.caption: 包层折射率接近纤芯，导光边界逐渐消失。
chapters.captionEn: As the cladding index reaches the core index, the guiding boundary disappears.

chapters.title: 同一时刻出发，不一定同时到达
chapters.titleEn: Together at launch, apart at arrival
chapters.caption: 不同路程带来不同延迟，叠加后的脉冲变宽。
chapters.captionEn: Different path lengths produce different delays and broaden the combined pulse.

chapters.title: 让明暗携带信息
chapters.caption: 按同一序列发出光脉冲，接收端延迟读出对应的比特。
chapters.captionEn: The receiver reads the same pulse sequence after a propagation delay.

chapters.title: 一位装不下二
chapters.titleEn: When one place is not enough
chapters.caption: 一位只表示零或一；一加一，把一进到左边。
chapters.captionEn: One bit holds zero or one; adding two ones carries into the next place.

chapters.title: 把加法拆成两个问题
chapters.caption: 异或门决定本位和，与门决定是否进位。
chapters.captionEn: XOR gives the sum bit; AND decides whether a carry is needed.

chapters.title: 还要接住上一级的进位
chapters.titleEn: Make room for the incoming carry
chapters.caption: 全加器同时处理两个输入位和上一级进位。
chapters.captionEn: A full adder combines two operand bits with an incoming carry.

chapters.title: 让相同的小电路排成一行
chapters.titleEn: Put the stages in a row
chapters.caption: 每一级的进位输出，接到更高一位的进位输入。
chapters.captionEn: Each carry output connects to the carry input of the next higher bit.

chapters.title: 一个进位，走过整串数字
chapters.titleEn: A carry across the whole word
chapters.caption: 255 加 1 让进位穿过所有八位，结果逐级确定。
chapters.captionEn: Adding 1 to 255 makes the carry pass through all eight stages.

chapters.title: 第九位去了哪里
chapters.titleEn: Keep track of the ninth bit
chapters.caption: 八位结果之外的进位，保留了数值 256 的信息。
chapters.captionEn: The carry beyond the eight-bit result preserves the value 256.

chapters.title: 同样的位串，可以有不同读法
chapters.titleEn: The same bits, a different interpretation
chapters.caption: 最高位进位与有符号溢出，描述不同的范围限制。
chapters.captionEn: Carry-out and signed overflow describe different range limits.

chapters.title: 每一步，都可以追踪
chapters.caption: 同一套逻辑门与进位连接，也能完成其他输入的加法。
chapters.captionEn: The same gates and carry connections add different input values.

chapters.title: 捏下去，远处发生了什么
chapters.caption: 主缸、油管和两侧活塞，把手指与碟片连起来。
chapters.captionEn: A master cylinder, a hose and two pistons connect your hand to the rotor.

chapters.title: 先关上通往储液腔的门
chapters.caption: 活塞越过补偿孔后，排液才进入封闭油路。
chapters.captionEn: Once the piston passes the compensation port, displacement enters the closed circuit.

chapters.title: 先走完间隙，再建立压力
chapters.titleEn: Take up the gap, then build pressure
chapters.caption: 两片刹车片接触碟片后，继续排液才明显增加压力。
chapters.captionEn: After both pads meet the rotor, further displacement raises pressure strongly.

chapters.title: 同样压力，不同面积
chapters.titleEn: The same pressure acts on different areas
chapters.caption: 相同表压作用在更大的活塞面积上，产生更大的推力。
chapters.captionEn: The same gauge pressure produces more force on a larger piston area.

chapters.title: 大主缸，短行程，也更费力
chapters.titleEn: A larger master trades travel for effort
chapters.caption: 保持同样压力，主缸变大时行程缩短、所需手力增加。
chapters.captionEn: At the same pressure, a larger master needs less travel and more hand force.

chapters.title: 同样捏动，气泡分走了行程
chapters.caption: 气泡可被明显压缩，同样行程下留下更低的油压。
chapters.captionEn: Compressible air absorbs displacement, leaving less pressure at the same stroke.

chapters.title: 手控制夹紧，动能变成热
chapters.titleEn: The hand controls the grip; motion becomes heat
chapters.caption: 摩擦制动力做功，把车辆动能转成热。
chapters.captionEn: Frictional braking work converts the vehicle’s kinetic energy into heat.

chapters.title: 释放，让油路回到起点
chapters.titleEn: Release and return to the starting state
chapters.caption: 松手后压力下降，刹车片退开，补偿孔重新打开。
chapters.captionEn: Releasing pressure retracts the pads and reopens the compensation port.

chapters.title: 同一颗月亮
chapters.caption: 改变的是视角，不是月球形状。
chapters.captionEn: The shape stays round; our view of the light changes.

chapters.title: 谁照亮月球
chapters.caption: 太阳始终照亮朝向它的半个球面。
chapters.captionEn: Sunlight illuminates the hemisphere facing the Sun.

chapters.title: 把视角接起来
chapters.caption: 月球位置、日照与观察画面一起变化。
chapters.captionEn: Position, sunlight and the observed face change together.

chapters.title: 走完一轮盈亏
chapters.caption: 八个观察点，连接同一轮盈亏。
chapters.captionEn: Eight observations trace one continuous cycle.

chapters.title: 满月不等于月食
chapters.caption: 轨道稍微倾斜，多数满月便错开地球的影子。
chapters.captionEn: A tilted orbit lets most full Moons miss Earth’s shadow.

chapters.title: 同一面朝向地球
chapters.caption: 公转一圈，自转一圈，同一面持续朝向地球。
chapters.captionEn: One spin per orbit keeps one face toward Earth.

chapters.title: 两种月长
chapters.caption: 绕恒星一圈后，还要追上改变的太阳方向。
chapters.captionEn: After one stellar circuit, the Sun’s direction has moved on.

chapters.title: 重新看一眼月亮
chapters.caption: 同一束阳光，同一个球面，一轮不断改变的观察。
chapters.captionEn: One light source, one sphere, a changing observation.

chapters.title: 两条铜线，一个磁路
chapters.caption: 两条电路没有相接；变化的磁通同时穿过两个绕组。
chapters.captionEn: The circuits are separate; changing flux links both windings.

chapters.title: 电压跟着斜率走
chapters.caption: 磁通到峰顶，电压过零；磁通过零，电压的绝对值最大。
chapters.captionEn: At a flux crest, voltage is zero; at zero flux, voltage magnitude is greatest.

chapters.title: 每一匝都算数
chapters.caption: 链接同一磁通的匝数翻倍，开路感应电压也翻倍。
chapters.captionEn: Double the turns linking the same flux and the open-circuit voltage doubles.

chapters.title: 闭合之后，电流出现
chapters.caption: 负载电流反抗原来的磁通变化，电源补充初级电流。
chapters.captionEn: Load current opposes the original flux change; the source supplies more primary current.

chapters.title: 升压，不凭空增加功率
chapters.caption: 相同理想输出功率下，电压提高，输出电流减小。
chapters.captionEn: At equal ideal output power, higher voltage comes with lower output current.

chapters.title: 直流只留下接通的变化
chapters.titleEn: DC: a transient, then a static field
chapters.caption: 限流直流使磁通逐渐稳定，次级电压随之衰减。
chapters.captionEn: Current-limited DC lets flux settle while the secondary voltage decays.

chapters.title: 热量去了哪里
chapters.caption: 叠片减少涡流损耗；铁损与绕组铜损分开计算。
chapters.captionEn: Laminations reduce eddy currents; core and copper losses are accounted for separately.

chapters.title: 维持变化，才能持续传递
chapters.caption: 相同交流电压下，提高频率所需的磁通摆幅更小。
chapters.captionEn: At the same AC voltage, higher frequency needs a smaller flux swing.

chapters.title: 一条指令，五个工位
chapters.caption: I1 从取指走到写回，仍要经过五拍。
chapters.captionEn: I1 takes five cycles from fetch through writeback.

chapters.title: 把空着的工位用起来
chapters.caption: I1 还没完成，I2 已经开始自己的第一步。
chapters.captionEn: I2 starts its first step before I1 has finished.

chapters.title: 更快的是完成的节奏
chapters.caption: 同一份程序，完成间隔缩短，单条延迟没有缩成一拍。
chapters.captionEn: The same program finishes sooner; one instruction does not shrink to one cycle.

chapters.title: 遇到还没写回的值
chapters.titleEn: A value that has not been written
chapters.caption: I3 需要 r1 和 r2；关闭前递时，必须等待正确的值。
chapters.captionEn: I3 needs r1 and r2; without forwarding, it must wait for their values.

chapters.title: 把结果直接交过去
chapters.caption: I3 从两处锁存值取得 4 和 7，在执行级算出 11。
chapters.captionEn: I3 takes 4 and 7 from two pipeline latches and computes 11 in EX.

chapters.title: 有一拍，不能省
chapters.caption: 加载在访存结束才有数据，I5 保持一拍，再接着计算。
chapters.captionEn: The load returns at the end of MEM; I5 waits one cycle, then continues.

chapters.title: 走错的路，要撤回
chapters.caption: 分支成立时，清除 I7、I8，从 I9 重新取指。
chapters.captionEn: Taking the branch flushes I7 and I8; fetch resumes at I9.

chapters.title: 最后把结果对上
chapters.caption: 八条有效指令：流水线 15 拍，逐条参考 40 拍，结果相同。
chapters.captionEn: Eight useful instructions: 15 pipelined cycles, 40 sequential cycles, identical results.

chapters.title: 光去哪里，场朝哪里
chapters.caption: 光沿轴向前，电场在横向振动。
chapters.captionEn: Light travels along the axis; its electric field oscillates across it.

chapters.title: 没有优先的方向
chapters.caption: 非偏振光的电场方向随时间变化，没有固定优先轴。
chapters.captionEn: Unpolarized light has no persistent preferred electric-field axis.

chapters.title: 第一片，留下半束
chapters.caption: 理想第一片转到任何方向，都透过非偏振入射的一半。
chapters.captionEn: The first ideal polarizer passes half of unpolarized input at any angle.

chapters.title: 投影，要取平方
chapters.caption: 第二片的透过率，取决于两轴夹角的余弦平方。
chapters.captionEn: The second filter transmits the squared cosine of the angle between the axes.

chapters.title: 交叉，投影归零
chapters.caption: 两轴相差 90°，末片没有可透过的电场分量。
chapters.captionEn: At 90°, no component of the arriving field passes the final filter.

chapters.title: 在中间，改变方向
chapters.caption: 中间轴转向 45°，交叉外片后重新透出 12.5%。
chapters.captionEn: Turning the middle axis to 45° restores 12.5% transmission through crossed outer filters.

chapters.title: 光变亮，能量没有增加
chapters.caption: 沿三片依次看：100% → 50% → 25% → 12.5%。
chapters.captionEn: Along the three-filter path: 100% → 50% → 25% → 12.5%.

chapters.title: 找到透光的角度
chapters.caption: 外片保持交叉，中间轴在 45° 时给出最大输出。
chapters.captionEn: With crossed outer filters, the middle axis gives maximum output at 45°.

chapters.title: 同一轨道，两种季节
chapters.caption: 同一纬度的南北两地，白昼长短在半年后交换。
chapters.captionEn: At opposite latitudes, long and short days swap after half an orbit.

chapters.title: 地轴留在空间里
chapters.caption: 地球沿圆轨道前进，地轴在空间中的方向保持不变。
chapters.captionEn: Earth follows its orbit while the axis keeps the same direction in space.

chapters.title: 同一束光铺开
chapters.caption: 太阳越低，同一束光铺得越开，单位水平面积入射越少。
chapters.captionEn: A lower Sun spreads the same beam across more horizontal area.

chapters.title: 一天能照多久
chapters.caption: 白昼越长，水平面接收阳光的时间就越长。
chapters.captionEn: A longer day gives the horizontal surface more time to receive sunlight.

chapters.title: 分点的平衡
chapters.caption: 分点时太阳赤纬为零；非极点地区的几何昼夜各占一半。
chapters.captionEn: At an equinox, zero declination divides geometric day and night equally away from the poles.

chapters.title: 午夜还看见太阳
chapters.caption: 越过极圈，太阳可以全天不落，也可以全天不升。
chapters.captionEn: Beyond the polar circle, the Sun can stay above or below the horizon all day.

chapters.title: 把地轴扶正
chapters.caption: 零倾角的圆轨道中，同一纬度的日照几何全年不变。
chapters.captionEn: With zero tilt and a circular orbit, the daily geometry at a fixed latitude stays the same all year.

chapters.title: 几何走到哪里
chapters.caption: 太阳高度与白昼时长决定几何入射；气温还需要热量收支。
chapters.captionEn: Sun height and daylight determine geometric input; temperature also needs an energy balance.

chapters.title: 先把支撑接起来
chapters.caption: 轴、内圈、滚珠、外圈、支座，组成连续的承载路径。
chapters.captionEn: Shaft, inner ring, balls, outer ring and housing form a connected load path.

chapters.title: 同时满足两处接触
chapters.caption: 球心前进与球的自转相加或抵消，分别跟上两条滚道。
chapters.captionEn: Translation and spin add at one contact and cancel at the other.

chapters.title: 公转和自转不是一回事
chapters.caption: 保持架跟随球心；球相对固定支座反向自转。
chapters.captionEn: The cage follows the centers; each ball spins oppositely in the fixed frame.

chapters.title: 把自转拿掉会怎样
chapters.caption: 人为禁止自转后，相同的球心速度会在两处接触产生滑动。
chapters.captionEn: Preventing spin creates slip at both contacts, even with the same center speed.

chapters.title: 同一颗球，轮流承载
chapters.titleEn: One ball enters the load zone
chapters.caption: 载荷方向固定；金色球进入亮区承载，离开后卸载。
chapters.captionEn: The load direction stays fixed while the gold ball enters and leaves the loaded region.

chapters.title: 点接触放大以后
chapters.caption: 真实承载会形成有限接触斑；放大图不表示真实尺寸。
chapters.captionEn: Real loading produces a finite contact patch; this enlargement is not to scale.

chapters.title: 滚动为什么仍有损耗
chapters.caption: 真实接触、局部滑动、润滑和可选的接触密封，都可能贡献损耗。
chapters.captionEn: Real contact, local slip, lubricant and optional contact seals can contribute losses.

chapters.title: 把整体重新接起来
chapters.caption: 滚珠协调两处接触，在支撑转轴的同时减少持续的宏观滑动。
chapters.captionEn: Coordinated rolling supports the shaft while reducing sustained macroscopic sliding.

chapters.title: 空管不会自己启动
chapters.titleEn: An empty tube does not start
chapters.caption: 顶部有空气，低出口也还不能形成虹吸。
chapters.captionEn: A low outlet is not enough while air interrupts the crest.

chapters.title: 先排气，再流动
chapters.caption: 预充器先做功；水柱连通后，落差接手。
chapters.captionEn: The primer supplies work first; the head difference then sustains flow.

chapters.title: 跟住一小份水
chapters.caption: 上升段爬高，整条水路却向更低处输水。
chapters.captionEn: One leg climbs, but the complete journey ends lower.

chapters.title: 顶部为什么低压
chapters.titleEn: Why pressure falls at the crest
chapters.caption: 压力与高度一起变化；自由出口回到环境压力。
chapters.captionEn: Pressure changes with elevation and returns to ambient at the free outlet.

chapters.title: 把出口抬到水面
chapters.titleEn: Raise the outlet to the surface
chapters.caption: 管长没有改变；落差减小，持续流量归零。
chapters.captionEn: Tube length is unchanged. Less head brings the sustained flow to zero.

chapters.title: 让空气进来
chapters.caption: 低出口仍在，进气却切断了连续液柱。
chapters.captionEn: The outlet is still low, but admitted air breaks the column.

chapters.title: 顶部不能无限升高
chapters.titleEn: The crest has a pressure limit
chapters.caption: 沿管最低压触及蒸气压时，单相水柱模型失效。
chapters.captionEn: The single-phase column fails when its lowest pressure reaches vapor pressure.

chapters.title: 大气压扮演什么角色
chapters.caption: 相同大气压不增加驱动水头，却改变水柱能保持的高度。
chapters.captionEn: Equal ambient pressures add no driving head, but change the column’s feasible height.

chapters.title: 从停着到转起来
chapters.caption: 磁场存在还不够；转动线圈，才让磁通随时间改变。
chapters.captionEn: A field alone is not enough; rotation makes the linked flux change.

chapters.title: 把线圈转过四分之一圈
chapters.caption: 磁通到极值时电压为零；转到磁通过零，电压的绝对值最大。
chapters.captionEn: At a flux extremum voltage is zero; at zero flux its magnitude is greatest.

chapters.title: 旋转与固定之间
chapters.caption: 两只完整滑环各接一个端头，固定电刷持续接触各自的环。
chapters.captionEn: Two complete rings keep separate endpoints connected to stationary brushes.

chapters.title: 一圈里的正与负
chapters.titleEn: Positive and negative within one turn
chapters.caption: 转过半圈以后，感应电压反号；完整滑环不会把它自动变成直流。
chapters.captionEn: After half a turn the induced voltage reverses; continuous rings do not rectify it.

chapters.title: 转快以后，什么一起改变？
chapters.titleEn: What changes when the shaft turns faster?
chapters.caption: 转速翻倍，电压幅值翻倍，物理周期减半。
chapters.captionEn: Double the speed: voltage amplitude doubles and physical period halves.

chapters.title: 接上负载，轴为什么更难转？
chapters.titleEn: Why does a connected load resist turning?
chapters.caption: 负载电流产生反向力矩；维持转速需要驱动轴持续做功。
chapters.captionEn: Load current creates opposing torque; maintaining speed requires shaft work.

chapters.title: 倒转，阻力也跟着反向
chapters.titleEn: Reverse the drive, reverse the braking torque
chapters.caption: 同一转角下反转轴，电压和电流反号，力矩仍反抗实际转动。
chapters.captionEn: Reverse the shaft at the same angle: voltage and current reverse, while torque still opposes motion.

chapters.title: 把一整圈的能量对上
chapters.caption: 本圈机械功，等于负载电能加内部损耗；磁场参与转换而不提供持续能量。
chapters.captionEn: Shaft work for this turn equals load energy plus internal loss; the field enables the conversion.

chapters.title: 读一个字节，带回一行
chapters.titleEn: Read one byte, fetch one line
chapters.caption: 缓存为空时，读取地址 1 会复制地址 0–3 的整行。
chapters.captionEn: Reading address 1 into an empty cache fetches the whole line at addresses 0–3.

chapters.title: 标签、组号与偏移
chapters.caption: 地址 18 拆成标签 1、组号 0、偏移 2；有效且标签匹配才命中。
chapters.captionEn: Address 18 has tag 1, set 0 and offset 2. A hit needs a valid, matching tag.

chapters.title: 空间局部性
chapters.caption: 邻近地址同属一行，后面的读取可以直接命中。
chapters.captionEn: Nearby addresses share a line, so later reads can hit.

chapters.title: 时间局部性
chapters.caption: 再次读取同一地址时，只要副本仍在，就不必重新搬运。
chapters.captionEn: Reusing an address needs no new fetch while its copy remains cached.

chapters.title: 空位之外，还有映射限制
chapters.caption: 地址 0 与 16 都只能去组 0，轮流替换；其余三组仍空着。
chapters.captionEn: Addresses 0 and 16 compete for set 0, evicting each other while three sets stay empty.

chapters.title: 容量相同，位置更灵活
chapters.caption: 同样六次读取、同样 16 B：直接映射零次命中，二路相联四次命中。
chapters.captionEn: Same six reads, same 16 B: zero direct-mapped hits, four two-way hits.

chapters.title: 真正的最近最少使用
chapters.caption: 再次读取 0 后，16 成为组内最久未用的行；32 到来时替换它。
chapters.captionEn: Reusing 0 makes line 16 the least recently used in its set; 32 replaces it.

chapters.title: 更大缓存行，公平比较
chapters.caption: 都保持 16 B：一字节行需要八次填充，四字节行只需两次。
chapters.captionEn: At 16 B capacity, one-byte lines need eight fills; four-byte lines need two.

chapters.title: 一条缝，宽亮带
chapters.titleEn: A narrow slit, a wide band
chapters.caption: 单缝之后，远处屏幕出现宽中央峰与较弱侧峰。
chapters.captionEn: A single slit makes a broad central maximum and weaker side peaks on a distant screen.

chapters.title: 正前方，同向相加
chapters.caption: 正前方，各段电场同相相加，形成中央峰。
chapters.captionEn: Straight ahead, all aperture strips add in phase to make the central maximum.

chapters.title: 第一暗纹，两两抵消
chapters.titleEn: The first minimum cancels in pairs
chapters.caption: 相距半个缝宽的对应段，在第一暗纹处相差半个波长。
chapters.captionEn: At the first minimum, matching strips half a slit-width apart differ by half a wavelength.

chapters.title: 电场反相，光强仍为正
chapters.caption: 电场可以反相；光强取合成场的模平方。
chapters.captionEn: The field can reverse phase; intensity is the squared magnitude of the resultant.

chapters.title: 开口越窄，亮带越宽
chapters.titleEn: A narrower slit spreads the pattern
chapters.caption: 缝宽减半，中央亮带的宽度约增加一倍。
chapters.captionEn: Halving the slit width approximately doubles the width of the central band.

chapters.title: 波长也决定张开角
chapters.caption: 同一狭缝中，长波长的第一暗纹离中心更远。
chapters.captionEn: Through the same slit, a longer wavelength moves the first minimum farther from the center.

chapters.title: 远场，不只看距离
chapters.caption: 屏幕靠近后，被忽略的孔径相位曲率不能再忽略。
chapters.captionEn: Bringing the screen closer makes the neglected aperture phase curvature matter.

chapters.title: 波长尺度的边界
chapters.caption: 零点方程有边界；没有有限零点，不等于没有衍射。
chapters.captionEn: The zero equation has limits; no finite zero does not mean no diffraction.

chapters.title: 先经过车轮，再到车身
chapters.caption: 轮胎、轮组、弹簧与减振器，把路面的变化传给车身。
chapters.captionEn: Tire, wheel, spring and damper connect road motion to the body.

chapters.title: 弹簧会把能量还回来
chapters.caption: 理想弹簧储能与放能；没有阻尼，振荡不会自行消失。
chapters.captionEn: An ideal spring stores and returns energy; without damping, oscillation persists.

chapters.title: 更软，仍然会振荡
chapters.caption: 较软弹簧改变静态下沉和振动节奏，却不能代替阻尼。
chapters.captionEn: A softer spring changes static sag and oscillation timing; it cannot replace damping.

chapters.title: 同一个凸起，两种衰减
chapters.caption: 保持弹簧不变，加入阻尼后，振荡能量逐渐离开系统。
chapters.captionEn: With the spring unchanged, damping lets oscillation energy leave the system.

chapters.title: 能量去了哪里
chapters.caption: 路面固定时，机械能减少的部分由减振器耗散；瞬时功率始终非负。
chapters.captionEn: With the road fixed, lost mechanical energy becomes damper dissipation; its power is nonnegative.

chapters.title: 阻尼不是越大越好
chapters.caption: 较大阻尼限制相对运动，也会更强地传递快速输入；比较同一凸起的加速度。
chapters.captionEn: Higher damping limits relative motion but can transmit rapid input more strongly; compare acceleration on the same bump.

chapters.title: 轮胎接触的边界
chapters.caption: 法向载荷降到零，线性轮胎模型停止；这里不推演离地后的运动。
chapters.captionEn: At zero normal load the linear tire model stops; airborne motion is not predicted.

chapters.title: 把三个目标接在一起
chapters.caption: 弹簧储能，减振器耗能，轮胎连接路面；一组参数不能替代完整的工况判断。
chapters.captionEn: The spring stores energy, the damper dissipates it, and the tire connects to the road.

chapters.title: 阀门先停下
chapters.caption: 靠近阀口的水先减速，远处仍在流动。
chapters.captionEn: Water near the valve slows before water farther upstream.

chapters.title: 跟着波前走
chapters.caption: 波前到达哪里，哪里的流动才开始改变。
chapters.captionEn: Local flow changes only when the wavefront arrives.

chapters.title: 水与管壁都让了一点
chapters.caption: 微小压缩与扩张，把动能暂时存成弹性能。
chapters.captionEn: Tiny compression and expansion store some kinetic energy elastically.

chapters.title: 水库把扰动反号送回
chapters.titleEn: The reservoir reverses the pressure disturbance
chapters.caption: 上游压力固定，返回的压力扰动必须反号。
chapters.captionEn: Fixed upstream pressure requires a reflected disturbance of opposite pressure sign.

chapters.title: 关阀处再反射
chapters.titleEn: A second reflection at the closed valve
chapters.caption: 关闭的阀门约束零流速，返回波再次改变压力。
chapters.captionEn: The closed valve enforces zero velocity as the returning wave changes pressure again.

chapters.title: 给反射留出时间
chapters.caption: 慢关过程中返回波已经到达，首个强峰被削弱。
chapters.captionEn: During slow closure, returning waves modify the flow before the valve finishes closing.

chapters.title: 改变弹性，不改变初速
chapters.titleEn: Change elasticity, keep the initial speed
chapters.caption: 管壁更软，波速降低，快速停止的首波幅度也降低。
chapters.captionEn: A softer wall lowers wave speed and the first rapid-stop pressure rise.

chapters.title: 在模型边界停下
chapters.caption: 到达蒸气压后，需要另一套物理才能继续。
chapters.captionEn: Beyond vapor pressure, further motion needs additional physics.

chapters.title: 在水面转一个弯
chapters.caption: 光线从空气进入水滴，向入口法线偏折。
chapters.captionEn: Entering water, the ray bends toward the local normal.

chapters.title: 光没有全部折回
chapters.caption: 背面同时反射和透射；主虹追踪其中反射的部分。
chapters.captionEn: The far surface both reflects and transmits; the primary follows the reflected part.

chapters.title: 回到空气中
chapters.caption: 再次折射后，主虹支路朝阳光来向附近返回。
chapters.captionEn: After the second refraction, the primary branch travels back toward the incoming side.

chapters.title: 相邻入口，接近的出口方向
chapters.caption: 入射位置继续移动时，出射角在驻值附近变化很小。
chapters.captionEn: Near the stationary entry, moving the incoming ray barely changes its outgoing angle.

chapters.title: 颜色分开，是方向略有不同
chapters.caption: 水的折射率随波长变化；红光的主虹角略大于紫光。
chapters.captionEn: Water’s index changes with wavelength; red has a slightly larger primary angle than violet.

chapters.title: 先固定一滴水
chapters.caption: 同一滴水中，红光朝向眼睛，同一入口的紫光偏离眼睛。
chapters.captionEn: At one droplet, red reaches the eye while violet at the same entry misses it.

chapters.title: 另一种颜色，来自另一条视线
chapters.titleEn: Another color, another line of sight
chapters.caption: 另一位置的水滴送来紫光；两种颜色从不同视线进入同一只眼睛。
chapters.captionEn: A second droplet sends violet to the same eye along a different line of sight.

chapters.title: 圆锥被地平线切开
chapters.caption: 虹围绕反太阳方向成圆；太阳升高时，地平线以上的弧段变少。
chapters.captionEn: The bow circles the antisolar direction; a higher Sun leaves less of it above the horizon.

chapters.title: 追踪绳上的点
chapters.caption: 波峰在前进，物质点只在原位振动。
chapters.captionEn: Crests travel; material points oscillate in place.

chapters.title: 相消的瞬间
chapters.caption: 同一点的正、负位移相加，可以恰好为零。
chapters.captionEn: Opposite displacements can sum to zero at the same point.

chapters.title: 平直仍有能量
chapters.caption: 位移抵消时，速度可以不为零，能量仍在。
chapters.captionEn: Displacement can cancel while velocity and energy remain.

chapters.title: 穿过而不交换
chapters.caption: 在线性理想绳中，两个脉冲保持形状穿过彼此。
chapters.captionEn: On an ideal linear string, both pulses pass through unchanged.

chapters.title: 改变相位差
chapters.caption: 同频同向波：从同相增强，转到反相抵消。
chapters.captionEn: Co-propagating waves go from reinforcement to cancellation as phase changes.

chapters.title: 反相还不够
chapters.caption: 完全抵消需要反相，也需要等振幅。
chapters.captionEn: Full cancellation requires equal amplitudes as well as opposite phase.

chapters.title: 波列进入，波节形成
chapters.caption: 反向波列真正进入并重叠，固定的波节逐渐显现。
chapters.captionEn: Incoming counterpropagating trains overlap and establish stationary nodes.

chapters.title: 不动的点，流动的能量
chapters.caption: 波节相隔半个波长；驻波仍有局部能量交换。
chapters.captionEn: Nodes are half a wavelength apart; local energy still exchanges.

chapters.title: 三相，合成一个转向
chapters.caption: 三相电流错开三分之一个周期，合成磁场持续转向。
chapters.captionEn: Three currents are a third of a cycle apart; their combined field keeps turning.

chapters.title: 磁场有自己的速度
chapters.caption: 这里是两极电机：50 Hz 的电源，对应每分钟 3000 转的磁场。
chapters.captionEn: This two-pole motor has a 50 Hz supply and a field that turns at 3000 rpm.

chapters.title: 没有接线，也能有电流
chapters.caption: 磁场掠过静止铜条；电流沿导条与两端铜环闭合。
chapters.captionEn: A moving field induces current in stationary bars; the two end rings close the paths.

chapters.title: 松开轴，转子开始追赶
chapters.caption: 电磁转矩先加速转子；转子接近磁场速度后，感应电流减小。
chapters.captionEn: Torque accelerates the rotor; induced current falls as it approaches the field speed.

chapters.title: 追上了，反而没有转矩
chapters.titleEn: Catch the field, lose the torque
chapters.caption: 把转子带到同步速度，转差为零，感应电流和电磁转矩也为零。
chapters.captionEn: At synchronous speed, slip is zero, so induced rotor current and torque are zero.

chapters.title: 多一点负载，多一点落后
chapters.caption: 比较稳定运行点：负载加大，转子稍慢，转差带来更大的转矩。
chapters.captionEn: At stable operating points, added load makes the rotor slightly slower and torque larger.

chapters.title: 换相序，重新启动
chapters.caption: 停机后交换两相再启动，磁场和转子的方向一起反转。
chapters.captionEn: After stopping, swapping two phases reverses the field and the restarted rotor.

chapters.title: 落后的那一部分，变成热
chapters.caption: 穿过气隙的功率，一部分变成机械功，一部分在转子里发热。
chapters.captionEn: Air-gap power splits into mechanical power and heat in the rotor.

chapters.title: 不变的发射节拍
chapters.caption: 双方静止时，传播只推迟到达，不改变间隔。
chapters.captionEn: With both bodies still, propagation delays arrivals without changing their spacing.

chapters.title: 圆心留在过去
chapters.caption: 声源移走后，每一圈仍以发射时的位置为圆心。
chapters.captionEn: After the source moves on, each circle stays centered at its emission position.

chapters.title: 前方更快到达
chapters.caption: 前方波长缩短；源频率不变，接收频率升高。
chapters.captionEn: The forward wavelength shrinks. Emission frequency stays fixed; reception frequency rises.

chapters.title: 后方需要多等一会
chapters.caption: 声源远离时，后方波长变长，到达节拍变慢。
chapters.captionEn: As the source recedes, rearward wavelengths lengthen and arrivals slow down.

chapters.title: 迎着波峰走
chapters.caption: 声源静止、波长不变，移动接收者仍能改变到达频率。
chapters.captionEn: With a stationary source and unchanged wavelength, receiver motion still changes arrival frequency.

chapters.title: 一起移动，节拍回归
chapters.caption: 两者同速前进：波长缩短与接收者远离的作用恰好抵消。
chapters.captionEn: At equal velocities, shorter forward crests and receiver recession exactly balance.

chapters.title: 声音来自较早的位置
chapters.titleEn: Sound comes from an earlier position
chapters.caption: 离轴经过时，沿真正的传播方向回看过去的发射点。
chapters.captionEn: During an off-axis pass, follow the actual propagation direction back to emission.

chapters.title: 接近声速的边界
chapters.caption: 声源仍低于声速；拥挤的波峰不能直接外推成激波模型。
chapters.captionEn: The source remains subsonic. Crowded crests are not a shock-wave model.

chapters.title: 一条水路，三个测压口
chapters.caption: 喉部更窄，水更快，开口水柱反而更低。
chapters.captionEn: The throat is narrower and faster, yet its pressure column is lower.

chapters.title: 同一份水，在窄处拉长
chapters.titleEn: One volume stretches through the throat
chapters.caption: 体积守恒把截面积与流速连在一起。
chapters.captionEn: Conserved volume connects cross-sectional area to velocity.

chapters.title: 把速度和压力放进同一本账
chapters.titleEn: Put pressure and speed in one account
chapters.caption: 水平无损时，总水头不变，压力与速度水头互相转换。
chapters.captionEn: In the horizontal lossless case, pressure and velocity head share a constant total.

chapters.title: 宽回来，压力也恢复
chapters.caption: 扩张段流速降低，理想无损出口恢复入口压力。
chapters.captionEn: The diffuser slows the flow and recovers inlet pressure in the ideal model.

chapters.title: 速度一样，压力还能不同
chapters.titleEn: Equal speed can still mean different pressure
chapters.caption: 等截面管抬高出口，速度不变，压力降低。
chapters.captionEn: Raising a uniform tube’s outlet lowers pressure without changing speed.

chapters.title: 水不动，仍有压力差
chapters.titleEn: Still water can have a pressure difference
chapters.caption: 零流量时，液面等高不代表各处压力相等。
chapters.captionEn: At zero flow, level column surfaces do not mean equal local pressure.

chapters.title: 把沿程损失算进去
chapters.caption: 同样的流量与几何，有损总水头沿管下降。
chapters.captionEn: With the same flow and geometry, loss makes total head decrease downstream.

chapters.title: 到蒸气压，模型停下
chapters.caption: 绝对压力触及蒸气压后，不再外推单相液流。
chapters.captionEn: A liquid-only solution is not continued past vapor pressure.

chapters.title: 四位数据，七个位置
chapters.caption: 四个数据位保留原值，三个校验位补足偶校验。
chapters.captionEn: Four data bits stay intact; three check bits make each group even.

chapters.title: 重叠形成位置指纹
chapters.titleEn: Overlap gives each position a signature
chapters.caption: 每个位参加不同的校验组合；位置 6 属于 C2、C4，不属于 C1。
chapters.captionEn: Each position has a different check signature; position 6 belongs to C2 and C4, but not C1.

chapters.title: 码字穿过信道
chapters.caption: 先对齐相同位编号，再让信道只翻转第 6 位。
chapters.captionEn: Align the same positions, then let the channel flip only position 6.

chapters.title: 把校验结果读成位置
chapters.titleEn: Read the syndrome as a position
chapters.caption: C4、C2、C1 的结果是 110₂ = 6；单错假设下定位第 6 位。
chapters.captionEn: C4, C2, C1 read 110₂ = 6, locating position 6 under the single-error assumption.

chapters.title: 翻回，再提取
chapters.caption: 只翻回第 6 位，校验归零，四位数据恢复为 1011。
chapters.captionEn: Flip only position 6 back; checks return to zero and the data returns to 1011.

chapters.title: 双错也能伪装
chapters.caption: 翻转 3、5 位也产生综合征 6；再翻 6 会通过校验，却交付错误数据。
chapters.captionEn: Flips at 3 and 5 also produce syndrome 6; flipping 6 then passes the checks but delivers wrong data.

chapters.title: 加上全字的奇偶检查
chapters.titleEn: Add a check across the whole word
chapters.caption: 相同双错下，s 非零而 q 为零；扩展码检出双错，拒绝误纠。
chapters.captionEn: For the same double error, s is nonzero and q is zero; the extended code detects it and refuses to correct.

chapters.title: 一位可纠，两位可检
chapters.caption: 在最多两位翻转的前提下区分四种情况；更多错误没有同样保证。
chapters.captionEn: Distinguish four cases under an at-most-two-flip assumption; larger errors carry no such guarantee.

chapters.title: 同一根车轴，走两条不同的弧
chapters.caption: 外侧车轮路程更长，需要转得更快。
chapters.captionEn: The outside wheel follows a longer path and must turn faster.

chapters.title: 直行时，行星齿轮只随壳体公转
chapters.caption: 两只半轴齿轮同速，行星齿轮相对壳体不自转。
chapters.captionEn: With equal side speeds, the pinions do not spin relative to the carrier.

chapters.title: 转弯时，行星齿轮还会自转
chapters.caption: 同一个锥顶、相交的轴线，保持齿面接触。
chapters.captionEn: A common cone apex and intersecting axes keep the tooth flanks in contact.

chapters.title: 平均转速由壳体决定
chapters.titleEn: The carrier sets the mean speed
chapters.caption: 一侧减少的转速，恰好由另一侧增加。
chapters.captionEn: A decrease on one side is matched by an increase on the other.

chapters.title: 固定一侧，另一侧转得更快
chapters.titleEn: Hold one side, speed up the other
chapters.caption: 这是固定一只车轮的试验，不是锁止差速器。
chapters.captionEn: This test holds one wheel; it does not lock the differential.

chapters.title: 分开看：转速与扭矩
chapters.caption: 理想、无损且忽略齿轮惯性时，两侧扭矩相等。
chapters.captionEn: The ideal, lossless model with negligible gear inertia gives equal side torques.

chapters.title: 弱侧的上限，会限制两侧
chapters.titleEn: The weaker limit constrains both sides
chapters.caption: 这里只计算可维持的扭矩上限，不预测打滑后的车速。
chapters.captionEn: This calculates sustainable torque limits, not vehicle speed after wheel slip.

chapters.title: 允许差速，保留机械联系
chapters.caption: 道路要求不同转速，齿轮约束它们的平均值。
chapters.captionEn: The road requires different speeds; the gears constrain their average.

chapters.title: 先发出一小段声音
chapters.caption: 有限脉冲离开探头，随后沿原声线返回。
chapters.captionEn: A finite pulse leaves the probe and later returns along the same ray.

chapters.title: 用往返时间定位
chapters.titleEn: Locate a boundary by its delay
chapters.caption: 先走到界面，再返回探头；往返时间除以二才给出深度。
chapters.captionEn: Travel to the boundary and back: divide the round-trip time by two to recover depth.

chapters.title: 反射一部分，继续走一部分
chapters.caption: 能量在界面分流；深部回波还要通过上方界面两次。
chapters.captionEn: Energy divides at a boundary; deeper echoes cross overlying interfaces on both legs.

chapters.title: 负回波也能成为亮线
chapters.titleEn: A negative echo can still be bright
chapters.caption: 先保留 RF 的符号与相位，再从相干信号求非负包络。
chapters.captionEn: Keep RF sign and phase, then obtain a nonnegative envelope from the coherent signal.

chapters.title: 一条 A 线，成为一列像素
chapters.titleEn: One A-line becomes one image column
chapters.caption: 每个停驻位置收齐回波，再按时间和亮度组成扫描列。
chapters.captionEn: At each stationary position, complete an echo record and map its timing and strength into a column.

chapters.title: 缩短脉冲，分开近邻
chapters.titleEn: Shorten the pulse to separate neighbors
chapters.caption: 同一片 0.64 mm 薄片：长脉冲合并，短脉冲分出两峰。
chapters.captionEn: The same 0.64 mm foil: a long pulse merges the returns; a short pulse separates two peaks.

chapters.title: 亮表面，暗后方
chapters.titleEn: A bright face with a darker region behind
chapters.caption: 增加嵌块衰减，前表面不变，深部回波变弱。
chapters.captionEn: Increase insert attenuation: its near face stays fixed while deeper echoes weaken.

chapters.title: 声速假设会移动图像
chapters.titleEn: An assumed speed moves the image
chapters.caption: 同一回波记录，用错误声速重建会定位过深；校准后恢复。
chapters.captionEn: The same record is placed too deep with an excessive assumed speed; calibration restores its position.

chapters.title: 先看挡住转动的那一组
chapters.titleEn: Start with a stack that blocks rotation
chapters.caption: 上弹子跨在固定外壳与锁芯之间。
chapters.captionEn: A driver pin bridges the fixed shell and the plug.

chapters.title: 钥匙沿着同一条通道推进
chapters.titleEn: The key advances through one keyway
chapters.caption: 钥匙先接触圆头，再把整组弹子推高。
chapters.captionEn: The key contacts the rounded tip and raises the entire stack.

chapters.title: 圆头沿齿形连续抬升
chapters.titleEn: Rounded tips follow the continuous profile
chapters.caption: 抬升来自实际接触；弹簧的两端始终有支承。
chapters.captionEn: Contact determines lift; both spring ends stay seated.

chapters.title: 不同长度，抵达同一边界
chapters.caption: 匹配的齿高与下弹子长度互相补足。
chapters.captionEn: Each matching cut complements its key-pin length.

chapters.title: 只差一处，仍然转不动
chapters.titleEn: One mismatch still blocks the plug
chapters.caption: 比较同一时刻：一个错误高度仍会阻挡锁芯。
chapters.captionEn: At the same instant, one incorrect height still blocks rotation.

chapters.title: 边界清空，锁芯才能转动
chapters.titleEn: Clear the boundary, then turn the plug
chapters.caption: 钥匙和下弹子随锁芯转，上弹子留在外壳里。
chapters.captionEn: The key and lower pins turn with the plug; drivers stay in the shell.

chapters.title: 先回正，再退出
chapters.caption: 转动时钥匙保持就位；回到入口位置后才能退出。
chapters.captionEn: The key stays seated while turned; withdrawal requires the home position.

chapters.title: 钥匙退出，弹子重新跨界
chapters.titleEn: Withdraw the key, restore the barrier
chapters.caption: 齿面离开后，弹簧使上弹子重新进入锁芯。
chapters.captionEn: As the profile leaves, springs return the drivers into the plug.

chapters.title: 先让电流交替
chapters.caption: 发送端先建立交流电流；没有电线跨过线圈之间的间隙。
chapters.captionEn: The transmitter establishes alternating current; no wire crosses the gap between the coils.

chapters.title: 变化的磁链，感应的电压
chapters.caption: 共享磁链的变化感应出电压；磁链最大时，瞬时感应电压恰好为零。
chapters.captionEn: Changing shared flux linkage induces voltage; at peak linkage the instantaneous induced voltage is zero.

chapters.title: 闭合接收回路
chapters.caption: 接收回路闭合以后，电流才流过交流负载，发送端也感受到这个负载。
chapters.captionEn: Closing the receiver circuit lets current reach the AC load and reflects that load back to the transmitter.

chapters.title: 让两只线圈靠近
chapters.caption: 线圈靠近，共享耦合增强；在当前运行范围里，负载得到更多功率。
chapters.captionEn: Closer coils share stronger coupling; in this operating range, the load receives more power.

chapters.title: 高度没变，耦合却减弱
chapters.caption: 侧向错开，即使距离不变，也会减少两个线圈共享的耦合。
chapters.captionEn: Lateral misalignment reduces shared coupling even when the vertical gap stays fixed.

chapters.title: 电容改变电路的节奏
chapters.caption: 电容抵消线圈的感抗；接近调谐频率，电流与接收功率明显改变。
chapters.captionEn: Capacitors cancel coil reactance; near the tuning frequency, current and received power change substantially.

chapters.title: 磁通也需要返回路径
chapters.caption: 移除铁氧体磁片，电感和互感一起改变，原来的调谐条件也随之改变。
chapters.captionEn: Removing ferrite changes inductance and mutual coupling, so the original tuning condition changes too.

chapters.title: 每一瓦都要有去处
chapters.caption: 线圈电阻增加，铜耗占比上升；负载、线圈和源电阻的功率始终对得上。
chapters.captionEn: Increasing winding resistance raises the copper-loss share; load and losses always sum to source power.

chapters.title: 线圈带动整个组件
chapters.caption: 磁路固定，音圈与锥盆连成同一个移动组件。
chapters.captionEn: The magnetic circuit stays fixed; coil and cone form one moving assembly.

chapters.title: 磁隙里的换向
chapters.caption: 同一磁场中，电流的正负决定电磁力方向。
chapters.captionEn: In a fixed field, reversing current reverses electromagnetic force.

chapters.title: 柔性的连续连接
chapters.caption: 折环与弹波允许轴向运动，并提供弹性回复。
chapters.captionEn: The surround and spider allow axial travel and provide restoring force.

chapters.title: 运动也能发电
chapters.caption: 回路保持闭合；线圈回弹产生反电动势。
chapters.captionEn: With the circuit closed, the returning coil generates back EMF.

chapters.title: 功率的去向
chapters.caption: 输入功率等于电阻损耗、机械耗散与储能变化率之和。
chapters.captionEn: Input power equals copper loss, mechanical loss and the change in stored energy.

chapters.title: 每个频率都不同
chapters.caption: 相同峰值电压下，各频率的稳态最大行程并不相同。
chapters.captionEn: At the same peak voltage, different frequencies produce different steady excursions.

chapters.title: 阻尼改变响应
chapters.caption: 增加阻尼会改变行程峰，也会通过反电动势改变电气响应。
chapters.captionEn: Damping changes excursion and feeds back into the electrical response.

chapters.title: 空气没有一路飞走
chapters.titleEn: Air does not travel with the wave
chapters.caption: 空气质点在附近往复，压缩图样向外传播。
chapters.captionEn: Air points oscillate nearby while the compression pattern travels outward.

chapters.title: 从网址，追踪一个 v
chapters.titleEn: Follow one v from the URL
chapters.caption: 同一个 v：118 → 01110110，始终追踪位 b6。
chapters.captionEn: The same v: 118 → 01110110. Keep following bit b6.

chapters.title: 先告诉读者怎样读
chapters.titleEn: Tell the reader how to read
chapters.caption: 模式、字节数、消息和终止位组成 19 个数据码字。
chapters.captionEn: Mode, byte count, message, and terminator form 19 data codewords.

chapters.title: 再算七个校验码字
chapters.caption: 19 个数据码字 → GF(256) → 7 个 RS 校验码字。
chapters.captionEn: 19 data codewords → GF(256) → 7 RS check codewords.

chapters.title: 先留出方向与尺度
chapters.caption: 先放功能图形，留下 208 个数据与校验位置。
chapters.captionEn: Function patterns leave 208 positions for data and checks.

chapters.title: 两列一组，把位放进去
chapters.titleEn: Place bits in pairs of columns
chapters.caption: 从右下折返放置；v 的位 b6 到达坐标 (13, 11)。
chapters.captionEn: Weave from the bottom right; v’s bit b6 reaches (13, 11).

chapters.title: 八种掩码，逐一比较
chapters.caption: 比较八种可逆掩码；此网址选择编号 3。
chapters.captionEn: Compare eight reversible masks; this URL selects mask 3.

chapters.title: 把解码说明写在两处
chapters.caption: L 等级 + 掩码 3 + BCH 校验 → 两份格式信息。
chapters.captionEn: Level L + mask 3 + BCH checks → two format copies.

chapters.title: 现在，它可以被扫描
chapters.caption: 退出教学高亮，保留四格静区，扫码读取真实网址。
chapters.captionEn: Remove teaching highlights, keep four quiet modules, and scan the real URL.

chapters.title: 对称的起点
chapters.caption: 对称翼型、零攻角：上下面压力相抵，升力为零。
chapters.captionEn: A symmetric section at zero incidence: the pressure loads balance, giving zero lift.

chapters.title: 改变迎风角度
chapters.caption: 只改变攻角，边界条件选出的速度场与压力一起改变。
chapters.captionEn: Change incidence: the boundary conditions select a new velocity field and pressure pattern.

chapters.title: 尖尾缘的约束
chapters.caption: 两侧趋近同一有限尾缘速度；环量必须满足这个条件。
chapters.captionEn: Both sides approach one finite trailing-edge velocity. Circulation must satisfy this condition.

chapters.title: 把一圈压力加起来
chapters.caption: 沿整圈表面积分压力载荷，上下面都参与合力。
chapters.captionEn: Add pressure loads around the entire surface. Both sides contribute to the resultant.

chapters.title: 不必同时抵达
chapters.caption: 同一时刻释放的相邻空气示踪点，不必同时经过翼尾。
chapters.captionEn: Nearby air tracers released together need not pass the trailing edge together.

chapters.title: 用另一条路径核对
chapters.caption: 闭合路径上的速度积分给出环量，不是空气在绕圈。
chapters.captionEn: Integrating velocity around a closed contour gives circulation, not an orbit of air.

chapters.title: 让升力反向
chapters.caption: 同一对称翼型，攻角变负，压力分布与升力翻转。
chapters.captionEn: With the same symmetric section, negative incidence reverses the pressure pattern and lift.

chapters.title: 风速与升力的平方
chapters.caption: 攻角不变：风速翻倍，理想压力载荷与升力变成四倍。
chapters.captionEn: Keep incidence fixed: double the wind speed and the ideal loads and lift become four times larger.

chapters.title: 物镜让光重新相遇
chapters.caption: 追踪一个标本点发出的光，直到它在中间像面重新会合。
chapters.captionEn: Follow light from one specimen point to its reunion at the intermediate plane.

chapters.title: 先得到一幅倒立实像
chapters.caption: 同一个点的位移在像面反向放大；这里物镜放大率为负十九。
chapters.captionEn: The point’s displacement is enlarged and reversed; this objective has magnification minus nineteen.

chapters.title: 目镜改变观察角度
chapters.caption: 中间像位于目镜前焦面，同一点对应一束平行出射光。
chapters.captionEn: With the image at the eyepiece front focus, each point produces a parallel outgoing bundle.

chapters.title: 用载物台把像调清楚
chapters.titleEn: Focus by moving the specimen stage
chapters.caption: 同一对荧光点经过离焦到清晰；变化来自标本与物镜的距离。
chapters.captionEn: The same fluorescent pair comes into focus as the specimen-to-objective distance changes.

chapters.title: 不同深度，轮流清晰
chapters.titleEn: Different depths come into focus in turn
chapters.caption: 两排点相隔二十微米；焦点沿深度移动，清晰的一排随之交换。
chapters.captionEn: The rows lie twenty micrometers apart in depth; moving focus swaps which row is sharp.

chapters.title: 孔径决定能分开多近
chapters.caption: 保持两点间距不变，打开物镜孔径，使衍射点像收窄。
chapters.captionEn: Keep point separation fixed and open the objective pupil to narrow its diffraction pattern.

chapters.title: 孔径也改变景深
chapters.titleEn: Aperture also changes depth of field
chapters.caption: 收小孔径让轴向响应变宽，同时牺牲相邻点的横向分离。
chapters.captionEn: A smaller pupil broadens the axial response while sacrificing lateral separation.

chapters.title: 放大模糊，不会增加细节
chapters.caption: 固定低孔径，只增加目镜放大；模糊变大，物方分辨尺度不变。
chapters.captionEn: Keep the low aperture fixed and increase eyepiece power: blur grows, but object-space resolution stays fixed.

chapters.title: 脉冲怎样变成直流
chapters.titleEn: From pulses to a steady output
chapters.caption: 开关节点在高低电压间切换；电感和电容把脉冲变成较平稳的输出。
chapters.captionEn: The switch node jumps between voltages; the inductor and capacitor smooth the output.

chapters.title: 第一条路径：接通
chapters.caption: 开关闭合，电源接入电感。电感两端电压为正，电流连续上升。
chapters.captionEn: With the switch closed, positive inductor voltage makes current rise continuously.

chapters.title: 第二条路径：续流
chapters.caption: 开关断开，电感电流不会突然消失；二极管接上另一条闭合路径。
chapters.captionEn: Opening the switch does not erase inductor current. The diode completes another loop.

chapters.title: 电感的伏秒平衡
chapters.caption: 周期稳态中，电感正负伏秒相抵；改变占空比，会改变新的平衡电压。
chapters.captionEn: In periodic operation, positive and negative inductor volt-seconds cancel. Duty changes the balance.

chapters.title: 电容接住电流差
chapters.caption: 电感电流超过负载需求时，电容充电；不足时补上差额。更大电容减小纹波。
chapters.captionEn: The capacitor absorbs surplus inductor current and supplies any shortfall. More capacitance reduces ripple.

chapters.title: 负载突然加重
chapters.caption: 负载突然加重，电容先补电流缺口；电感电流随后改变。这里没有稳压反馈。
chapters.captionEn: A heavier load draws first on the capacitor; inductor current responds afterward. There is no feedback regulator here.

chapters.title: 第三段：电流归零
chapters.titleEn: A third interval at zero current
chapters.caption: 负载变轻，电流降到零后，二极管阻止反向流动，出现第三段空闲时间。
chapters.captionEn: At light load, current reaches zero. The diode blocks reversal, leaving a third, idle interval.

chapters.title: 每一份能量都有去向
chapters.titleEn: Accounting for every part of the energy
chapters.caption: 加入导通损耗，同一占空比的输出降低；输入能量分给负载、储能变化和热。
chapters.captionEn: Conduction losses lower the output at the same duty. Input energy accounts for load, storage change, and heat.

chapters.title: 先把文字交给字节
chapters.caption: 跟住 a 的 b0：字节 0x61 → 消息字 W[0]。
chapters.captionEn: Follow a’s b0: byte 0x61 → message word W[0].

chapters.title: 给消息一个准确的结尾
chapters.titleEn: Give the message an exact ending
chapters.caption: 原消息 + 一位 1 + 零 + 64 位长度字段 → 512 位块。
chapters.captionEn: Message + one 1 bit + zeros + 64-bit length → 512-bit blocks.

chapters.title: 十六个字，展开成六十四个
chapters.caption: 从已有的 16 个 32 位字，算出 64 个轮用消息字。
chapters.captionEn: Expand 16 original 32-bit words into 64 round words.

chapters.title: 放慢看一轮
chapters.caption: 消息与状态形成 T1、T2，再更新 a 与 e。
chapters.captionEn: Message and state form T1 and T2, then update a and e.

chapters.title: 八个状态字，接力六十四轮
chapters.caption: 每轮把八个状态字交给下一轮；W 和 K 随轮次改变。
chapters.captionEn: Each round passes eight state words onward; W and K change with the round.

chapters.title: 别忘了加回起点
chapters.caption: 八个工作字逐项加回块输入，拼成最终 256 位摘要。
chapters.captionEn: Add each working word to its incoming state word to form the 256-bit digest.

chapters.title: 消息可以长，摘要长度不变
chapters.titleEn: Longer messages, the same digest length
chapters.caption: 双块示例：前块链值进入后块，最终仍输出 256 位。
chapters.captionEn: Two-block example: pass the chaining value onward; the final output stays 256 bits.

chapters.title: 只改一位，再算一次
chapters.titleEn: Change one bit and calculate again
chapters.caption: 同一输入只翻转一位：实测差异，不是安全性证明。
chapters.captionEn: Flip one bit of the same input: measured differences, not a security proof.

chapters.title: 两个互不接触的回路
chapters.caption: 线圈回路接回电源，锅底中的等效电流自行闭合。
chapters.captionEn: The coil returns to its source; induced current closes within the pan.

chapters.title: 盯住磁通的变化率
chapters.caption: 感应电动势由外加磁通的变化率决定，电流还受回路阻抗影响。
chapters.captionEn: Induced voltage follows changing applied flux; loop impedance also shapes current.

chapters.title: 热从多深的地方产生
chapters.titleEn: How deep is the electrical heating?
chapters.caption: 频率升高，集肤深度变小，周期平均电损耗更靠近锅底入射面。
chapters.captionEn: Higher frequency reduces skin depth and concentrates electrical loss near the driven face.

chapters.title: 抬高同一口锅
chapters.caption: 固定线圈电流和频率，增加间距会减弱互感与锅底功率。
chapters.captionEn: At fixed coil current and frequency, more spacing weakens coupling and pan power.

chapters.title: 导体不只有一种
chapters.caption: 同样的驱动下，材料会改变电阻、相位和发热；非磁性导体也可被感应加热。
chapters.captionEn: With the same drive, material changes resistance and heating; nonmagnetic conductors can also heat.

chapters.title: 开启一段，停顿一段
chapters.caption: 缩短通电时间比例降低时间平均功率；停顿不代表锅已经冷却。
chapters.captionEn: Less on-time lowers average power; an off interval does not mean a cold pan.

chapters.title: 锅先热，玻璃后热
chapters.titleEn: The pan warms before the glass
chapters.caption: 电损耗先进入锅体，随后通过接触传热使玻璃升温。
chapters.captionEn: Electrical loss heats the pan first; contact then warms the glass.

chapters.title: 断电以后，热还在走
chapters.caption: 断电后总储热持续减少，玻璃仍可能短暂升温。
chapters.captionEn: After power-off, total stored heat falls even while glass may briefly warm.

chapters.title: 一根针，怎样留下两根线？
chapters.caption: 铜红色上线穿过针眼；青绿色底线来自下方梭心。
chapters.captionEn: The copper upper thread passes through the eye; the teal lower thread comes from the bobbin.

chapters.title: 针回升，线环才出现
chapters.titleEn: A small rise makes a loop
chapters.caption: 针先到底，再稍稍抬起：针后留出可供梭尖进入的线环。
chapters.captionEn: After bottom dead centre, a small rise leaves a loop behind the needle.

chapters.title: 梭尖进入针后的线环
chapters.titleEn: The hook meets the rising needle
chapters.caption: 旋梭连续转动，梭尖在针回升时接住上线。
chapters.captionEn: The rotating hook picks up the upper loop as the needle rises.

chapters.title: 上线绕过整只梭心套
chapters.titleEn: The loop travels around the case
chapters.caption: 两条线腿分到梭心套前后，底线被包含在线环之内。
chapters.captionEn: The two loop legs pass behind and in front of the case, enclosing the lower thread.

chapters.title: 线环脱离旋梭，走向前侧
chapters.titleEn: The loop comes off the hook
chapters.caption: 上线从梭心套外缘绕到前面；旋梭继续空转。
chapters.captionEn: The loop clears the case rim toward the front while the hook continues rotating.

chapters.title: 挑线杆把大环收成一针
chapters.titleEn: Take-up turns the loop into a stitch
chapters.caption: 挑线杆上升，外侧线环缩小，在布内与底线交锁。
chapters.captionEn: The take-up lever rises, shrinking the loop into an interlock within the fabric.

chapters.title: 针已经离布，送布牙再推进
chapters.titleEn: Clear the needle, then move the cloth
chapters.caption: 本模型先收紧，再送布；针仍在布内时，织物保持不动。
chapters.captionEn: This model tightens before feeding; the cloth stays still while the needle is in it.

chapters.title: 针距改变，交锁关系不变
chapters.titleEn: A longer feed changes the spacing
chapters.caption: 改变送布距离，两针之间的跨度改变，两根线仍在布内相扣。
chapters.captionEn: A longer feed increases stitch spacing while preserving the two-thread interlock.

chapters.title: 正半周的两只二极管
chapters.titleEn: Two diodes in the positive half-cycle
chapters.caption: A 端电压较高时，D1 和 D4 接通；电流从负载上端流入，下端流出。
chapters.captionEn: With A higher, D1 and D4 conduct. Current enters the top of the load and leaves the bottom.

chapters.title: 换一条路，方向不变
chapters.titleEn: A different route, the same direction
chapters.caption: 交流极性反转，换成 D2 和 D3 导通；流过负载的方向保持不变。
chapters.captionEn: Reversed AC selects D2 and D3. Current still passes through the load in the same direction.

chapters.title: 每周期得到两个脉冲
chapters.titleEn: Two output pulses per AC cycle
chapters.caption: 两个半周都变成正向输出，但每次过零仍会下落：整流还不等于平滑。
chapters.captionEn: Both half-cycles give positive output, but it still falls near every zero crossing. Rectification leaves ripple.

chapters.title: 第一次给电容充电
chapters.titleEn: Charging the capacitor for the first time
chapters.caption: 接入空电容后，只有源电压足够高时才充电；电容电压从零连续升起。
chapters.captionEn: An empty capacitor charges only once the source is high enough. Its voltage rises continuously from zero.

chapters.title: 不是整个半周都在充电
chapters.caption: 源电压幅值超过电容电压与两只二极管压降之和，桥才导通；其余时间由电容供电。
chapters.captionEn: The bridge conducts above vC plus two diode drops. Between those windows, the capacitor supplies the load.

chapters.title: 电容改变纹波
chapters.caption: 增大电容，同一负载下的电压下落变小；补充电荷仍集中在导通窗口里。
chapters.captionEn: A larger capacitor loses less voltage between recharges. Bridge current still arrives in charging windows.

chapters.title: 负载与频率的拉锯
chapters.caption: 负载加重会加快放电；把交流频率加倍，补充电荷的间隔变短，纹波又减小。
chapters.captionEn: A heavier load discharges C faster. Doubling AC frequency shortens recharge intervals and reduces ripple.

chapters.title: 浪涌与源电阻
chapters.caption: 在电压峰值接入空电容，会出现浪涌；增大源电阻能限制峰值，也会减慢充电。
chapters.captionEn: Connecting an empty capacitor at the voltage crest causes inrush. More source resistance limits it and slows charging.

chapters.title: 先有传导
chapters.caption: 没有流动，热也会扩散；完全对称的初态不会凭空长出涡旋。
chapters.captionEn: Heat diffuses without flow. An exactly symmetric initial state does not invent a vortex.

chapters.title: 给温度一点扰动
chapters.caption: 重置为导热温度层，加入相同的小扰动，看它能否长大。
chapters.captionEn: Start from a conductive temperature layer with a small prescribed disturbance. Can it grow?

chapters.title: 暖流开始上升
chapters.caption: 下热上冷时，温度扰动与浮力耦合，逐渐形成上升暖流。
chapters.captionEn: With warmth below, temperature disturbances couple to buoyancy and grow into rising currents.

chapters.title: 追踪一团流体
chapters.caption: 上升必须有回流；亮点和染料由同一个封闭速度场搬运。
chapters.captionEn: Rising flow needs a return path. Tracers and dye follow the same closed-cell velocity field.

chapters.title: 拿掉浮力再比较
chapters.caption: 保留相同温差，去掉浮力耦合：传导仍在，携热流动消失。
chapters.captionEn: Keep the temperature difference and remove buoyancy: conduction remains, but circulating heat transport disappears.

chapters.title: 把暖板放在上面
chapters.caption: 只交换冷热板，扰动不再长大；热从上方主要靠传导向下走。
chapters.captionEn: Swap the warm and cool plates. The disturbance decays, and heat travels mainly downward by conduction.

chapters.title: 撤去温差以后
chapters.caption: 把两板调到同温，余热与惯性不会瞬间消失，流动逐步衰减。
chapters.captionEn: Set both plates to one temperature. Stored heat and motion remain briefly, then the flow decays.

chapters.title: 看清计算的边界
chapters.titleEn: What the grid can tell us
chapters.caption: 加密网格仍得到对流，但数值会变化；本演示不测量临界阈值。
chapters.captionEn: A finer grid still gives convection, with different numbers. We do not measure an onset threshold.

chapters.title: 先过能量门槛
chapters.caption: 越过带隙才可能激发电荷对；多出来的光子能量先变成热。
chapters.captionEn: A photon must cross the bandgap to excite a pair; excess photon energy becomes heat.

chapters.title: 一对电荷分开走
chapters.caption: 一对等量异号电荷同时出现；结区电场让电子与空穴向相反方向移动。
chapters.captionEn: Equal opposite charges appear together. The junction field separates electrons and holes.

chapters.title: 外面的路也要闭合
chapters.caption: 电子沿接点、导线与负载返回；空穴留在电池内，闭合路径才持续输出。
chapters.captionEn: Electrons return through contacts, wire and load. Holes stay in the cell; sustained output needs a closed path.

chapters.title: 负载选择工作点
chapters.caption: 负载直线与 I–V 曲线的交点，决定真实电流、电压与输出功率。
chapters.captionEn: The load line meets the I–V curve at the actual current, voltage and power.

chapters.title: 两种零输出
chapters.titleEn: Two ways to get zero power
chapters.caption: 开路有电压却没有外电流；短路有电流却没有负载电压。两者输出都为零。
chapters.captionEn: An open circuit has no external current; a short has no load voltage. Both deliver zero power.

chapters.title: 光照把曲线抬起来
chapters.caption: 增加照度提高光生电流；暗态的被动负载没有可用输出。
chapters.captionEn: More irradiance raises photocurrent. In darkness, a passive load receives no power.

chapters.title: 更热不等于更强
chapters.caption: 这组硅电池参数中，升温略增短路电流，却降低开路电压与最大功率。
chapters.captionEn: For this silicon model, warming slightly raises short-circuit current but lowers open-circuit voltage and maximum power.

chapters.title: 每一份能量有去处
chapters.caption: 先减少被收集的电荷，再增大串联电阻：复合与发热是不同损失。
chapters.captionEn: First reduce collection, then increase series resistance: recombination and heating are different losses.

chapters.title: 把一把钥匙放到公开处
chapters.titleEn: Put one key in public view
chapters.caption: 公开 n 和 e；发件人可算出密文，d 由收件人保管。
chapters.captionEn: Publish n and e so anyone can compute ciphertext. The recipient keeps d private.

chapters.title: 两种指数，从哪里来
chapters.titleEn: Where the two exponents come from
chapters.caption: 由不同素数构造 n，再求 e 在模 λ 下的逆元 d。
chapters.captionEn: Build n from distinct primes, then find d as the inverse of e modulo λ.

chapters.title: 只留下整除后的余数
chapters.caption: 消息只能取 0 到 n−1；mod 表示余数，不是普通除法。
chapters.captionEn: Messages range from 0 to n−1. The mod operation returns a remainder.

chapters.title: 把幂拆开，算出密文
chapters.titleEn: Split the power to compute the ciphertext
chapters.caption: 指数 7 = 1 + 2 + 4；平方得余数，选中后逐项乘入。
chapters.captionEn: The exponent 7 is 1 + 2 + 4. Square, reduce, and multiply the selected terms.

chapters.title: 私人指数把消息带回来
chapters.titleEn: The private exponent brings the message back
chapters.caption: 同一密文改用指数 23；跳过 8，最后恢复消息 42。
