chapters.captionEn: Apply exponent 23 to the ciphertext. Skip power 8 and recover message 42.

chapters.title: 零和不互素的数，也要回来
chapters.titleEn: Zero and shared factors must work too
chapters.caption: 逐个检查边界与不互素消息；两边素数的余数都必须恢复。
chapters.captionEn: Check boundaries and shared factors. Both prime remainders must return correctly.

chapters.title: 算得回来，不代表守得住
chapters.titleEn: A round-trip is not a security guarantee
chapters.caption: 不填充的 RSA 是确定性的；小消息可以逐个公开猜测。
chapters.captionEn: Unpadded RSA is deterministic. Small messages can be guessed using the public key.

chapters.title: 真实系统，多做了什么
chapters.caption: 现代 RSA 加密需要安全填充；混合方案用随机密钥保护内容。
chapters.captionEn: Modern RSA encryption needs secure padding. Hybrid schemes protect content with a random key.

chapters.title: 低输入接通上拉路径
chapters.titleEn: A low input opens the pull-up path
chapters.caption: A 为 0，上拉给电容充电；输出电压逐渐升高。
chapters.captionEn: With A at 0, the pull-up charges the capacitor and the output rises.

chapters.title: 高输入接通下拉路径
chapters.titleEn: A high input opens the pull-down path
chapters.caption: A 为 1，上拉断开，下拉让电容连续放电。
chapters.captionEn: With A at 1, the pull-up opens and the capacitor discharges through the pull-down.

chapters.title: 与非门：下拉必须串通
chapters.caption: 两个下拉串联；任一个没有接通，输出就不能沿它们放电。
chapters.captionEn: The pull-down devices are in series; either open switch breaks the discharge path.

chapters.title: 或非门：一条下拉就够
chapters.titleEn: NOR needs only one pull-down path
chapters.caption: 下拉改成并联，任一高输入都能拉低输出。
chapters.captionEn: Parallel pull-down paths let either high input pull the output low.

chapters.title: 电压要穿过中间区域
chapters.caption: X 表示不能保证的逻辑读数；电容电压仍有确定数值。
chapters.captionEn: X marks an unguaranteed logic reading; the capacitor voltage remains definite.

chapters.title: 更大的负载需要更久
chapters.caption: 10 fF 换成 40 fF，电阻不变，半电压时间增加到四倍。
chapters.captionEn: Changing 10 fF to 40 fF quadruples half-voltage time at the same resistance.

chapters.title: 变化沿两级电路传播
chapters.titleEn: A transition travels through two stages
chapters.caption: Y₁ 穿过模型界线后，第二级才开始改变 Y₂。
chapters.captionEn: Only after Y₁ crosses the model boundary does the second stage begin changing Y₂.

chapters.title: 一次翻转，能量去了哪里
chapters.caption: 充电把能量分给电容与热，随后放电把储能也变成热。
chapters.captionEn: Charging divides energy between storage and heat; discharging turns the stored part into heat.

chapters.title: 两种宿主，一层隔膜
chapters.caption: 锂储存在宿主里，隔膜保持两极分开。
chapters.captionEn: Lithium sits in hosts; the separator keeps the electrodes apart.

chapters.title: 两条路，同一次放电
chapters.caption: 锂离子向内穿行，电子经过外部负载。
chapters.captionEn: Ions travel internally; electrons pass through the external load.

chapters.title: 让离子过，不让电子过
chapters.caption: 同一组身份保持不变，路径不会跨错材料。
chapters.captionEn: Tracer identities stay fixed, and their paths respect the materials.

chapters.title: 电量对应锂的搬移
chapters.caption: 两极含锂比例一减一增，总量保持不变。
chapters.captionEn: One host loses lithium as the other gains it; total inventory stays fixed.

chapters.title: 电流变大，压降出现
chapters.caption: 内阻立刻降压，极化随后变化，内部持续发热。
chapters.captionEn: Resistance acts immediately; polarization follows, with internal heat loss.

chapters.title: 电压回升，不是电量回生
chapters.caption: 断流后 SOC 不变，极化储能释放为热。
chapters.captionEn: At zero current, SOC stays fixed while polarization energy becomes heat.

chapters.title: 提供能量，沿原路返回
chapters.titleEn: Supply energy and reverse the paths
chapters.caption: 充电源做功，锂回到石墨，电子方向也反转。
chapters.captionEn: The charger does work as lithium returns to graphite and electrons reverse.

chapters.title: 到边界，停止继续充入
chapters.caption: 容量端点触发断流，能量账目始终闭合。
chapters.captionEn: The usable capacity limit stops current, while energy accounting stays balanced.

chapters.title: 轮子想转，摆在把关
chapters.titleEn: The wheel wants to turn; the pendulum gates it
chapters.caption: 重锤拉动卷筒；擒纵轮被两块擒纵瓦交替拦住。
chapters.captionEn: The weight pulls the drum; two pallets alternately hold the escape wheel.

chapters.title: 锁住轮子，摆仍在走
chapters.titleEn: The wheel rests while the pendulum moves
chapters.caption: 锁面是以锚轴为圆心的圆弧：摆动时，齿尖停在原处。
chapters.captionEn: The locking arc is centred on the anchor arbor, so the tooth stays put as the anchor swings.

chapters.title: 齿尖滑过冲量面
chapters.titleEn: The tooth crosses the impulse face
chapters.caption: 齿尖越过锁角，沿平面冲量面推进；随后进入短暂跌落。
chapters.captionEn: The tooth passes the locking corner, drives along the impulse plane, then briefly drops free.

chapters.title: 出口瓦接住下一步
chapters.titleEn: The exit pallet catches the next step
chapters.caption: 出口瓦先锁住轮子，待摆返回，再从另一方向传递冲量。
chapters.captionEn: The exit pallet locks first, then delivers an impulse on the returning swing.

chapters.title: 一次往返，恰好一个齿距
chapters.titleEn: One full swing, one tooth pitch
chapters.caption: 每半次往返放行一次；完整往返后，30 齿轮前进 12°。
chapters.captionEn: There is one release per half-swing; a full swing advances this 30-tooth wheel by 12°.

chapters.title: 补回损失，摆幅才留得住
chapters.caption: 同一起点与阻尼：自由摆衰减；理想中点补能维持能量范围。
chapters.captionEn: Same start and damping: the free swing decays; ideal centre impulses sustain its energy range.

chapters.title: 摆变长，放行的节拍变慢
chapters.titleEn: A longer pendulum releases more slowly
chapters.caption: 相同计时窗口里，较长的摆周期更长，累计放行更少。
chapters.captionEn: Over the same time window, a longer pendulum has a longer period and fewer releases.

chapters.title: 重锤供能，钟摆定拍
chapters.titleEn: The weight supplies energy; the pendulum sets the beat
chapters.caption: 锁定限制轮的推进；冲量补偿损失；摆长决定近似周期。
chapters.captionEn: Lock limits the wheel, impulse replaces losses, and length sets the approximate period.

chapters.title: 先逐页翻完这张表
chapters.titleEn: Read the table page by page
chapters.caption: 查找键 63：完整扫描要检查全部 24 行。
chapters.captionEn: Finding key 63 requires scanning all 24 rows.

chapters.title: 分隔键，是通往下一页的路标
chapters.titleEn: Separators point to the next page
chapters.caption: 分隔键决定下一页；键相同，再比较行号。
chapters.captionEn: Separators choose the next page; row IDs break ties.

chapters.title: 沿着页号，找到同一条记录
chapters.titleEn: Follow page IDs to the same record
chapters.caption: 沿子页指针下降，再用行号取回完整记录。
chapters.captionEn: Follow child pointers, then fetch the record by row ID.

chapters.title: 少翻了几页，账要算完整
chapters.titleEn: Count every page on both routes
chapters.caption: 同一结果：全扫 6 页，索引 4 页加堆页 1 页。
chapters.captionEn: Same result: scan 6 pages, or read 4 index pages plus 1 heap page.

chapters.title: 范围查询，顺着叶页接着走
chapters.titleEn: Continue a range along the leaves
chapters.caption: 沿叶页查找 38–47；三个 42 各有独立行号。
chapters.captionEn: Follow leaves for 38–47; all three 42s retain their row IDs.

chapters.title: 叶页满了，把新邻居接进来
chapters.titleEn: A full leaf gains a new neighbor
chapters.caption: 第 4 项撑满叶页：分裂，并把右页最小项复制到父页。
chapters.captionEn: A fourth entry splits the leaf; copy the right minimum to its parent.

chapters.title: 分裂向上传，直到长出新根
chapters.titleEn: Splits climb until a new root grows
chapters.caption: 分裂传到根时，所有叶子统一加深一层。
chapters.captionEn: A root split adds one level to every leaf.

chapters.title: 读得越多，索引越不占便宜
chapters.titleEn: Reading more can erase the advantage
chapters.caption: 读全部 37 行：索引触及 27 页，全扫只需 10 页。
chapters.captionEn: Read all 37 rows: the index touches 27 pages; a scan needs 10.

chapters.title: 只盯住这一颗
chapters.caption: 没有整体水流，微球仍留下不规则轨迹。
chapters.captionEn: Even without mean flow, the sphere wanders.

chapters.title: 把时间放到纳秒
chapters.caption: 热浴与阻力的冲量，共同改变微球动量。
chapters.captionEn: Bath and drag impulses change the sphere’s momentum.

chapters.title: 惯性会被忘记
chapters.caption: 关闭热噪声，已有速度按时间常数 τ 衰减。
chapters.captionEn: With thermal noise off, velocity decays on the timescale τ.

chapters.title: 拉回秒尺度
chapters.caption: 远大于 τ 时，同一热浴的两种轨迹几乎重合。
chapters.captionEn: Far beyond τ, both descriptions nearly coincide for the same bath.

chapters.title: 只改变热浴温度
chapters.caption: 固定黏度与半径：升温使扩散系数 D 增大。
chapters.captionEn: At fixed viscosity and radius, higher temperature increases D.

chapters.title: 阻力改变游走尺度
chapters.caption: 黏度乘三，D 除三；半径乘二，D 减半。
chapters.captionEn: Triple viscosity: D divides by three. Double radius: D halves.

chapters.title: 把重复实验叠起来
chapters.caption: 单次位移平方会起落；多次平均接近理论均方位移。
chapters.captionEn: One squared displacement fluctuates; trial averages approach the MSD.

chapters.title: 平均位置不是一条命运
chapters.titleEn: The mean is not a particle
chapters.caption: 平均位置接近起点，典型离开距离却持续增大。
chapters.captionEn: The mean stays near the start while typical displacement grows.

chapters.title: 从浓到淡
chapters.titleEn: From a peak to a spread
chapters.caption: 峰变矮、两侧变宽；封闭带中的总量不变。
chapters.captionEn: The peak spreads; the sealed strip’s total stays constant.

chapters.title: 坡度决定净通量
chapters.caption: 同一截面：浓度坡度越缓，净通量越小。
chapters.captionEn: At a fixed section, a gentler slope means less net flux.

chapters.title: 一小段的收支
chapters.caption: 局部先积累、再流出；封闭带的总量始终守恒。
chapters.captionEn: A region gains, then loses material; the sealed total is conserved.

chapters.title: 边界让宽度停下
chapters.caption: 方差起初近似线性增长，随后受封闭边界限制。
chapters.captionEn: Variance first grows almost linearly, then meets the boundary limit.

chapters.title: 改变扩散系数
chapters.caption: 相同初态：D 加倍，等效于基准组的两倍模型时间。
chapters.captionEn: Same initial state: double D equals twice the baseline model time.

chapters.title: 长度的平方
chapters.caption: 初态同比放大：长度加倍，同等相对平滑需四倍时间。
chapters.captionEn: Scale the initial shape: double length takes four times as long to smooth.

chapters.title: 混合而不消失
chapters.caption: A、B 逐渐重叠；各自总量与总浓度都不变。
chapters.captionEn: A and B overlap; each amount and their total concentration stay fixed.

chapters.title: 有通量的稳态
chapters.caption: 储库维持浓度差：曲线逐渐稳定，净通量仍存在。
chapters.captionEn: Reservoirs maintain the gradient: the profile approaches steady state while flux continues.

chapters.title: 分组只选择下一跳
chapters.titleEn: Each router chooses a next hop
chapters.caption: 目的地始终是 R；每台路由器只选择下一跳。
chapters.captionEn: Destination R stays fixed; each router chooses only the next hop.

chapters.title: 最短的是路由代价
chapters.caption: 仅改变 B–R 代价，收敛后的最短路径随之改变。
chapters.captionEn: Change only B–R cost: the converged least-cost path changes.

chapters.title: 先排队，再逐位发送
chapters.caption: 一个出口依次发送分组，后来者先排队。
chapters.captionEn: An output sends one packet at a time; later arrivals queue.

chapters.title: TTL 限制转发次数
chapters.caption: 转发前 TTL 减一；减到零，分组就被丢弃。
chapters.captionEn: TTL drops before forwarding; at zero, the packet is discarded.

chapters.title: 故障先被邻居发现
chapters.titleEn: A neighbor notices the failure first
chapters.caption: B–R 中断，P1 丢失；远处路由器还不知道。
chapters.captionEn: B–R fails and P1 is lost; remote routers do not know yet.

chapters.title: 更新传播后，路由才收敛
chapters.caption: B 已改道，C 仍用旧表；更新传完前可能绕圈。
chapters.captionEn: B updates before C; a temporary loop lasts until convergence.

chapters.title: 队列满了，分组会被丢弃
chapters.titleEn: A full queue drops arriving packets
chapters.caption: 同样十个分组：加等待位可减少丢弃，出口速率不变。
chapters.captionEn: Same ten packets: more queue slots reduce drops but do not speed up output.

chapters.title: 先到达，不一定先交付
chapters.titleEn: Arrival order is not delivery order
chapters.caption: 后发的 P4 先到；顺序交付仍要等待缺失分组。
chapters.captionEn: P4 arrives ahead of earlier packets; ordered delivery waits for the gap.

chapters.title: 拉头经过，齿留在身后
chapters.titleEn: A moving slider, a lasting join
chapters.caption: 拉头改变相遇路径，齿留在连续织带上。
chapters.captionEn: The slider changes the meeting path; the teeth stay attached to their tapes.

chapters.title: 宽齿头里藏着一道齿窝
chapters.titleEn: A recess inside the broad head
chapters.caption: 剖去 L7 的上唇，看对侧薄翼进入齿窝。
chapters.captionEn: Cut away L7’s upper lip to see the opposite wing inside its recess.

chapters.title: Y 形通道让两条带转弯
chapters.titleEn: The Y guide turns the tapes
chapters.caption: 外导边与中心楔限定两条连续的弯曲路径。
chapters.captionEn: Outer flanges and a central diamond bound two continuous curved paths.

chapters.title: 跟着 L7 走进咬合
chapters.caption: 半齿距错位与转弯配合，让宽头进入邻齿之间。
chapters.captionEn: Half-pitch staggering and rotation let the broad head enter between its neighbours.

chapters.title: 横着拉，为什么分不开
chapters.titleEn: Why a sideways pull is resisted
chapters.caption: 在对称刚体假设下，两处肩面各承担 F/2。
chapters.captionEn: Under the symmetric rigid-body assumption, each shoulder carries F/2.

chapters.title: 倒着走，同一颗齿退出
chapters.titleEn: The same tooth follows the reverse route
chapters.caption: 拉头改变退出方向，让相互阻挡的肩面逐步分离。
chapters.captionEn: The slider changes the exit direction so the retaining shoulders can separate.

chapters.title: 上下止限定这段旅程
chapters.caption: 上止挡住拉头；下止连接两条带并限制下行。
chapters.captionEn: Top stops block the slider; the bottom stop joins the tapes and limits downward travel.

chapters.title: 去掉宽肩，结果就变了
chapters.titleEn: Remove the shoulder, change the result
chapters.caption: 相同横移尝试下，宽肩保留阻挡；削肩假想齿可退出。
chapters.captionEn: With the same attempted shift, broad shoulders retain; hypothetical narrow heads can withdraw.

chapters.title: 都在落向月球
chapters.caption: 近侧、地心、远侧都向月球加速，但加速度不一样。
chapters.captionEn: Near side, center and far side all accelerate toward the Moon, by different amounts.

chapters.title: 跟地心一起下落
chapters.caption: 减去地心加速度后，近侧相对向月，远侧相对背月；两边都远离地心。
chapters.captionEn: Subtract the center acceleration: the near and far sides both stretch away from the center.

chapters.title: 海面跟随同一个势
chapters.caption: 形变逐渐放大：同一潮汐势让理想海面在近、远两端隆起。
chapters.captionEn: Magnify the deformation: one tidal potential raises the ideal surface on both sides.

chapters.title: 距离的三次方
chapters.caption: 潮汐的主导项随距离的三次方衰减，比整体引力更敏感。
chapters.captionEn: The leading tidal term falls with distance cubed, more steeply than bulk attraction.

chapters.title: 把太阳项加进来
chapters.caption: 太阳也贡献潮汐项；日月同向时，两者的形变增强。
chapters.captionEn: The Sun also contributes. Aligned lunar and solar tides reinforce the deformation.

chapters.title: 大潮与小潮
chapters.caption: 日月成直线时，赤道平衡潮差较大；成直角时较小。
chapters.captionEn: Alignment gives a larger equatorial equilibrium range; a right angle gives a smaller one.

chapters.title: 让观测点转过一圈
chapters.caption: 在固定月球方向的平衡模型里，赤道观测点转过一圈，经过两个高度峰值。
chapters.captionEn: With the Moon fixed, an equatorial site crosses two ideal height peaks per relative turn.

chapters.title: 峰值没有统一答案
chapters.caption: 纬度可以让理想峰值不等高，甚至只剩一个；真实海岸还取决于海盆动力学。
chapters.captionEn: Latitude can make the ideal peaks unequal or remove one. Real coasts also depend on basin dynamics.

chapters.title: 一斗土，三支油缸
chapters.caption: 钢臂没有变长，变长的是油缸。
chapters.captionEn: The steel arms never change length; the cylinders do.

chapters.title: 切开动臂缸
chapters.caption: 油进入无杆腔，推动活塞，活塞杆顶起动臂。
chapters.captionEn: Oil fills the cap end, pushes the piston, and the rod lifts the boom.

chapters.title: 一条闭合的油路
chapters.caption: 发动机带动泵送出流量，阀芯决定油去哪个腔。
chapters.captionEn: The engine drives the pump; the spool decides where the oil goes.

chapters.title: 压力由载荷决定
chapters.caption: 连通的油液压力处处相等；面积大三十六倍，推力大三十六倍。
chapters.captionEn: One pressure everywhere; 36 times the area, 36 times the force.

chapters.title: 推杆多少，走多快
chapters.caption: 手柄推阀芯，阀口开多少，进多少油。
chapters.captionEn: The lever moves the spool; the opening meters the flow.

chapters.title: 同一斗土，不同的姿态
chapters.caption: 同样的载荷，力矩和力臂都随姿态改变。
chapters.captionEn: The same load, but moment and lever arm change with pose.

chapters.title: 铲斗的四连杆
chapters.caption: 直线推力经摇臂和连杆，变成铲斗的收拢。
chapters.captionEn: A straight push becomes bucket curl through the rocker and link.

chapters.title: 撬不动的石头
chapters.caption: 压力到达限压，油从溢流阀回油箱，动臂不再上升。
chapters.captionEn: At the relief setting, oil returns to tank and the boom stops rising.

chapters.title: 多一道缝，反而更暗
chapters.caption: 多开一道缝，有些地方却更暗。
chapters.captionEn: Two open slits can make a dark fringe.

chapters.title: 跟住屏幕上的一点
chapters.caption: 光程差增加一个波长，相位再次重合。
chapters.captionEn: One wavelength of path difference restores phase.

chapters.title: 先加电场，再算亮度
chapters.caption: 先叠加电场，再计算光强。
chapters.captionEn: Add the fields before finding intensity.

chapters.title: 两缝拉开，条纹变密
chapters.caption: 两缝拉开，条纹变密。
chapters.captionEn: Farther slits make closer fringes.

chapters.title: 波长变长，条纹变疏
chapters.caption: 波长变长，条纹变疏。
chapters.captionEn: Longer wavelengths spread the fringes.

chapters.title: 缝变宽，包络变窄
chapters.caption: 缝变宽，外层包络变窄。
chapters.captionEn: Wider slits narrow the outer envelope.

chapters.title: 一个点，一个点地积累
chapters.caption: 一次次探测，积累出条纹。
chapters.captionEn: Individual detections build up the fringes.
